If the instrument hits a teammate, increases the main attack stat boost by an extra 25% (rapidly diminishes over 4s).
Enemies who touch the link take 30 (30 + 25% magical attack) magical damage every 0.5s.
Passive: Increases his physical attack by 30, magical attack by 65, and Movement Speed by 7.5%.

skill2.description:
Ming throws his instrument. If it hits an enemy hero, it links to them. If it misses, it automatically links to an enemy hero within range. The instrument reduces the linked enemy's physical defense and magical defense by 10%. If the instrument hits an enemy hero, it reduces their physical defense and magical defense by an extra 25% (rapidly diminishes over 4s).
Enemies who touch the link take 30 (30 + 25% magical attack) magical damage every 0.5s.
Passive: Increases his physical defense and magical defense by 15%.

skill3.description:
After channeling for 0.75s, Ming deals true damage to an enemy linked to his instrument and restores Health to a linked teammate.
If the instrument is linked to 1 target, Ming spends 600 (600 + 125% magical attack) of his own Health to deal an equal amount of true damage to the target if it's an enemy, or to restore an equal amount of Health if it's a teammate.
If the instrument is linked to 2 targets, Ming steals 600 (600 + 125% magical attack) Health from the enemy and gives it to the teammate.
If the targets die before Ming finishes channeling, 70% of the cooldown is returned. The Health spent is slowly restored over 5s.

strategy.earlyGame: Ming is an aggressive enchanter support who directly amplifies one ally's stats. Use Skill 1 to link to your jungler or marksman. In the early game, the link massively boosts your linked ally's physical and magical attack, making them overwhelmingly strong. Play hyper-aggressively alongside them to invade and dominate the lane.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, glue yourself to your most fed ally. Use Skill 2 to toggle the link between the offensive (red) and defensive (yellow) stances. If your carry's HP is healthy, stay on red to maximize their damage; the moment they get focused, swap to yellow to boost their physical and magical defense.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, your positioning is tied completely to your linked carry. You are the ultimate walking stat buff. Your Ultimate sacrifices your own HP to instantly mega-heal your linked ally (or deal true damage to a linked enemy). Whatever happens, keep your hypercarry alive.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, stay directly behind your linked carry. Toggle Skill 2 based on whether your carry is dealing damage or taking it. The moment an assassin dives your carry, hit your Ultimate to mega-heal them, effectively granting a second life. Then peel with your passive's basic attack stun.

combos.title: Hypercarry Sustain
combos.description: Skill 1 (link ally) -> Skill 2 (swap to yellow) -> Ultimate (Skill 3). Keep your ally linked, switch to defensive mode when the enemy engages, and turn the fight around with your Ultimate's burst heal.

combos.title: Aggressive True Damage Execute
combos.description: Skill 1 (link enemy) -> Skill 2 (swap to red) -> Ultimate (Skill 3). Link an enemy target, shred their defenses with the red link, then use your Ultimate to slam them with massive AP-scaling true damage.

strategy.commonMistakes: Drifting too far from your ally and breaking the link. Forgetting to swap to the defensive (yellow) stance while your ally is eating burst damage. Being late with your Ultimate's heal.

strengths: A specialized support who transforms a single ally into the strongest carry on the map, thanks to the huge offensive boost from Skill 1 and the instant mega-heal from Skill 3. The defense shred from Skill 2 is also potent, and combined with the passive's healing, it keeps your partner's combat power at an overwhelming level at all times.
weaknesses: Has virtually no solo combat power or self-defense, and contributes nothing without a competent ally to empower. The link also has a limited range, so a highly mobile ally can leave you behind and break the link, rendering you useless. With no area crowd control, you have no way to stop a hard enemy engage.

synergy.reason: Provides strong CC and defensive buffs from the early game, perfectly supporting Pei's aggressive jungle invades.
Long-range poke whittles down enemies, making it easy for Pei to clean up kills in Tiger form.

counters.reason: High mobility and i-frames allow her to dodge Pei's burst and easily counterattack.
Team-wide health rewinds and movement buffs in teamfights severely reduce Pei's kill potential.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Blast
passive.description: While in human form, Pei's Basic Attack range is increased and each Basic Attack restores 5 Energy to him. His Basic Attack also deals an extra 20 magical damage. This extra damage can stack up to 3 times when attacking the same target within 3s.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Striker Stance
skill1.description: Pei fires Inner Energy in the target direction, dealing magical damage to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 25% for 1.5s. Recovers 20 Energy when Skill 1 hits.

forms.description: Pei fires Inner Energy in the target direction, dealing magical damage to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 25% for 1.5s. Recovers 20 Energy when Skill 1 hits.
Pei swipes at the target, dealing physical damage. An extra 1% damage is dealt to the target for every 1% of their lost Health. If this skill defeats the target enemy, he recovers 20 Energy.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Guarding Stance
skill2.description: Pei envelops himself in Beastly Instincts, dealing magical damage to nearby enemies while creating a shield that negates damage and increasing his Attack Speed by 30% for 5s. While the shield is active, he deals magical damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

forms.description: Pei envelops himself in Beastly Instincts, dealing magical damage to nearby enemies while creating a shield that negates damage and increasing his Attack Speed by 30% for 5s. While the shield is active, he deals magical damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

Pei pounces in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies in his path. If he pounces into terrain, he will latch on for 1s, during which he can pounce again by using the movement wheel, dealing physical damage to enemies in his path. If his pounce hits any enemy, he recovers 20 Energy and reduces Skill 2's CD by 30%.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Tiger Form
skill3.description: Pei switches to tiger form, gaining 15% Movement Speed for 1s and enhancing his next 2 Basic Attacks for 5s. First Enhanced Basic Attack: He dashes at the target, dealing physical damage and inflicting them with extreme slow. Second Enhanced Basic Attack: He deals magical damage to enemies within range in front of him.

forms.description: Pei switches to tiger form, gaining 15% Movement Speed for 1s and enhancing his next 2 Basic Attacks for 5s. First Enhanced Basic Attack: He dashes at the target, dealing physical damage and inflicting them with extreme slow. Second Enhanced Basic Attack: He deals magical damage to enemies within range in front of him.

Pei switches to Human Form, gaining 15% Movement Speed for 1s and enhancing his next Basic Attack for 5s. The enhanced Basic Attack allows him to fire a stronger Inner Energy at the target, dealing magical damage to the target and enemies in a cone-shaped area behind them.

strategy.earlyGame: Pei is an aggressive jungle assassin/marksman with two forms. His Ultimate is available from level 1, letting him swap between human form (ranged poke) and tiger form (melee burst). Clear your jungle quickly in tiger form and invade the enemy jungle aggressively at level 2. His early-game combat power is unmatched.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, dictate the map's tempo with constant invades and objective control. In human form, poke with Skill 1 and buff your attack speed with Skill 2. Once an enemy drops below half HP, transform into tiger form, leap over walls with Skill 2, and burst them down with your empowered basic attack and Skill 1 bite.
strategy.lateGame: Both forms are fragile, so late-game teamfights demand extreme care. Start fights as a pure human-form marksman: poke, whittle down the tanks, and apply your red buff slow. Only commit to tiger form when you see a clear window to clean up low-HP targets.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, stay in human form. Spam Skill 1 for poke and use Skill 2 for its shield and attack speed buff while you kite the frontline. Once the enemy's CC is spent and a target drops below 40% HP, transform with your Ultimate and pounce on the squishies with Skill 2 to execute them.

combos.title: Tiger Cleanup
combos.description: Human Skill 1 -> Skill 3 (transform) -> Tiger Skill 2 (wall jump) -> empowered basic attack -> Tiger Skill 1. Poke in human form, transform into the tiger, use a wall for the double-jump to reach your target, then finish them with the empowered attack into the bite.

combos.title: Human Form Kite
combos.description: Tiger Skill 3 (transform) -> Human Skill 2 -> basic attack -> Human Skill 1. Swap back to human form for range, trigger your shield and attack speed buff, then kite backwards with basic attacks while throwing energy bolts to apply slows.

strategy.commonMistakes: Diving into a 5v5 teamfight in tiger form from the start and getting instantly focused down. Failing to exploit the wall-based double-jump mechanic on tiger form's Skill 2.

strengths: His greatest strength is the flexibility to switch between human mode's sustained ranged damage and shield-based self-defense, and tiger mode's high mobility and dive burst. His early-game skirmishing is exceptional, and Skill 1's percentage damage lets him hurt even enemy tanks, making him a true all-rounder.
weaknesses: He has no hard CC (stuns, etc.) whatsoever, so he cannot fully lock enemies down and partly depends on his team's CC. Mastering both modes demands sharp situational judgment, and in late-game 5v5 teamfights his short range and low durability get exposed, making his positioning extremely unforgiving.

synergy.reason: Stealth and a strong group pull make it incredibly easy for Kuang Tie to land his AoE skills on multiple targets.
Ultimate shields and teleportation safely back up Kuang Tie's aggressive dives.

counters.reason: Strong shields negate Kuang Tie's damage, leading to losing trades in the laning phase.
True damage completely bypasses Kuang Tie's reliable shields to deal massive damage.

passive.description:
Biron's mace accumulates charge when he lands hits with Basic Attacks or unenhanced skills.
At 30 charge or more, his mace becomes Electrified. Basic Attacks deal 40 (40 + 14% extra physical damage) physical damage and restore 70 (70 + 1.5% extra Health) Health to him. Skills also receive different enhancement effects, but hits from enhanced skills do not build up charge.
Basic Attack hits accumulate 5-10 charge, and skill hits accumulate 8-16 charge. He can stock up to 90 charge.

skill1.description:
Swings his weapon twice, dealing 265 (265 + 100% extra physical damage) physical damage each time and restoring 100 (100 + 1.5% extra Health) Health, plus an extra 2% of lost Health.
Electrified Enhancement: Damage is increased to 400 (400 + 150% extra physical damage) physical damage, and restoration is increased to 200 (200 + 2.3% extra Health) Health, plus 4% of lost Health.

skill2.description:
Dashes forward, dealing 281 (150 + 75% physical damage) physical damage to enemies in his path. The next Basic Attack after the dash is enhanced, dealing 375 (200 + 100% physical damage) physical damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 2s.
Electrified Enhancement: If he has accumulated 30 charge or more, the enhanced Basic Attack deals 562 (300 + 150% physical damage) physical damage. It also launches and stuns targets for 1s, then slows them by 25% for 1s.
The first enhanced Basic Attack costs 30 Energy.

skill3.description:
Biron slams his mace into the ground, dealing 450 (450 + 120% extra physical damage) physical damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 1.5s. He also generates a shield that negates 900 (900 + 18% extra Health) damage for 6s.
Electrified Enhancement: Increases damage to 580 (580 + 195% extra physical damage) physical damage and boosts the shield to negate 1,450 (1,450 + 21% extra Health). Also generates an electric wave that deals 200 (200 + 75% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies and steals 25 Movement Speed from each hero, granting it to Biron.
The range of the electric wave increases with the Ultimate's level.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early game, Biron is a lane-dominant Clash Lane fighter built around managing his energy gauge. Basic attacks and skills generate energy, and with at least one bar (30+), his skills become empowered with massive damage and healing. Always hit minions to keep your energy topped up before taking a fight.
strategy.midGame: His mid-game teamfight presence is overwhelming. Look for flank engages that catch multiple enemies. Biron's AoE damage and healing scale with the number of enemies hit. Position with the Skill 2 dash, then unleash an empowered Skill 1 to shred the enemy frontline and backline at once.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, he serves as a frontline diver and disruptor. As long as your empowered Skill 1 and Ultimate are hitting multiple targets, you can tank enormous amounts of damage. He is vulnerable to heavy CC and kiting, however, so always keep Flash ready for important engages.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, charge your energy on jungle camps or minions beforehand if you can. Dive in with Skill 2, knock up the priority target with your empowered basic attack, immediately slam down your Ultimate for the slow and a huge shield (generating more energy), then finish with empowered Skill 1's AoE burst and healing.

combos.title: Full Energy Annihilation
combos.description: Skill 2 (dash) -> empowered basic attack (knock-up) -> Skill 3 -> empowered Skill 1. Dive in and launch the enemy, crack the ground with your Ultimate to steal a shield and deal damage, then finish with the empowered Skill 1 spin, healing as you kill.

combos.title: Lane Trade Spin
combos.description: Build one energy bar -> Skill 1 (empowered) -> Skill 2 (disengage). Walk up, land the empowered electric spin to drain big damage and healing off enemies and minions, then immediately dash back to safety.

strategy.commonMistakes: Charging in with zero energy, only able to cast weak unempowered skills with no healing, and dying for it. Getting kited and missing your empowered Skill 1 on the priority target.

strengths: His empowered skills at 30+ energy are tremendous: massive healing from Skill 1, guaranteed hard CC from Skill 2, and a huge shield from Skill 3 — everything a fighter needs, all at a high level. His Skill 1 comeback healing from low HP in particular is among the best of any hero in the game.
weaknesses: All of his power depends on energy, so in situations where he cannot charge up before a fight (such as being shoved under his own tower), his combat power plummets. His skills also have very short range, so ranged heroes with plenty of slows and other crowd control can kite him endlessly while he can do nothing about it.

synergy.reason: Compensates for the lack of mobility with speed buffs, facilitating smooth tower sieges with summoned bots.
Peels enemies away, creating a safe environment for Milady to summon bots and land her ultimate.

counters.reason: Ignores the bots and uses high mobility to quickly close the gap and instantly burst them down.
Can easily wipe out entire armies of painstakingly summoned bots with wide AoE skills.

passive.description:
When Milady defeats an enemy, a mechanical minion is summoned to automatically attack other enemies for 6s. At the end of their duration, minions merge with another nearby minion of the same level and upgrade themselves (up to a max of Lvl 3). If there are no suitable minions to merge with, they self-destruct, dealing 200 (200 + 30% magical attack) magical damage (explosion radius increases with minion level).
Minion Basic Attack: 120 (120 + 25% magical attack) magical damage. Health: 500 (500 + 110% magical attack).
Movement Speed: 450 (450 + 10% magical attack).
Minions deal 75% damage to structures. Merging increases Basic Attack and self-destruction damage by 30%, and max Health by 20%.
Up to 4/2/1 minion(s) can exist at the same time. Once exceeding the limit, older minions will attempt to merge or self-destruct.

skill1.description:
Milady commands an aircraft to fly in the target direction, attacking the enemy nearest to it multiple times along its path. Each attack deals 65 (65 + 10% magical attack) magical damage. After every two attacks, the aircraft attacks the nearest target an extra time, dealing 140 (140 + 20% magical attack) magical damage.
Using this skill again during flight splits the aircraft into two smaller aircraft. Each attacks the enemy nearest to it multiple times, dealing 65 (65 + 10% magical attack) magical damage. Enemies attacked by both aircraft have their Movement Speed reduced by 25% for 1.5s.

skill2.description:
Milady airdrops 2 mechanical minions in the target location, dealing 100 (100 + 20% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies upon landing. The mechanical minions activate after a 1s delay to search for the nearest enemy to attack.
She stocks 1 charge of this skill every 12-15s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), up to 3 charges.

skill3.description:
Milady fires a signal device at a target enemy or structure, marking it for 3s. Non-structure units are stunned for 0.75s. While marked, the target takes 80 (80 + 4% magical attack) magical damage every 0.5s and is slowed by 15%. When the mark expires, it explodes, dealing magical damage to the target and nearby enemies, equal to 25% of the total damage taken during the mark's duration.
If the target dies while marked, immediately summons 3 mechanical minions. While the Ultimate is active, allied mechanical minions in range gain 100% Attack Speed and Movement Speed, and will rush to attack the marked target.
Can be used on structures, but does not stun them.

strategy.earlyGame: Milady is a push-focused mid lane mage who fights through her mechanical minions. Spam Skill 2 to summon robots and relentlessly shove the minion wave into the enemy tower. By forcing the enemy mage to play defense under tower, you generate enormous map pressure and free rotations for your jungler.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, your one and only goal is taking towers. The moment the enemy mid laner roams to a side lane, punish them: use your machine army and your Ultimate (which can target towers) to melt the mid tier 1 and tier 2 towers instantly. Avoid river fights without your teammates.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, her raw teamfight damage falls off compared to traditional burst mages, but nobody out-sieges her. Play safely from the backline, send waves of robots into the enemy base to soak tower shots, and grind down the inhibitor towers on the high ground.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, stay far away from enemy assassins. Constantly produce robots with Skill 2 and throw Skill 1 planes for poke and slows. If an assassin dives you, hit them directly with your Ultimate to stun them and amplify your robots' damage, then run for your life.

combos.title: Tower Demolition
combos.description: Skill 2 (x2) -> Skill 3 (on tower) -> Skill 1. Summon a swarm of robots, fire your Ultimate directly at the enemy tower to amplify the damage it takes, then throw planes to demolish the structure at high speed.

combos.title: Anti-Dive Stun
combos.description: Skill 3 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> escape. When dived, immediately Ultimate the assassin to stun and mark them, drop robots at your feet to swarm them, and throw Skill 1 as you retreat.

strategy.commonMistakes: Walking the river or jungle alone without vision — Milady has zero mobility and dies instantly when ganked. Forgetting that her Ultimate deals devastating siege damage to enemy towers.

strengths: Her greatest strength is summoning swarms of robots to fight in her place, delivering overwhelming push power and tower destruction from a safe distance. Because robots can soak tower shots, she can break towers even without minions. Her Skill 3's guaranteed single-target stun and the burst from frenzied robots are also potent.
weaknesses: She has zero mobility and is extremely defenseless against assassins who ignore her robots and dive through them, or against long-range attacks. She also struggles to deal damage once enemies escape her robots' attack range, and AoE magic damage can wipe her robot army in an instant, so certain enemy compositions can completely shut down her strengths.

synergy.reason: High mobility ADC; Yao's shields and CC perfectly support his ultimate dives.
A highly mobile assassin; with Yao attached, they can execute devastating ganks while ignoring terrain.

counters.reason: Anti-shield passive and long range make it incredibly easy for her to strip Yao's main strength: her shields.
Overwhelming burst damage can instantly delete the possessed ally, shields and all.

passive.description: When affected by hard crowd control effects (excluding suppression effects), Yaria instantly removes all crowd control effects from herself and turns into a deer spirit for 4s. While in deer spirit form, she gains new skills, and all of her skills' cooldowns are refreshed. During this period, she cannot use Basic Attacks or be targeted, and nearby enemies are slowed by 15%. This effect has a 60-48s cooldown (depending on skill level).

skill1.description:
Yaria directs a soul with her staff, dealing 250 (250 + 30% magical damage) to enemies in its path and knocking them back. The soul will track the nearest enemy hero after reaching its max range, dealing 250 (250 + 30% magical damage) to them, launching them for 0.5s, and exposing them for 5s.
Deer Spirit Form: Deer spirit form ends instantly.

skill2.description:
Yaria deals 200 (200 + 30% magical damage) to the 3 closest random enemies within 5s, prioritizing heroes. She cannot use Basic Attacks for the duration of the skill.
Deer Spirit Form: Leaps forward.

skill3.description:
Attaches to a teammate, granting them a shield that negates 1,000 (1,000 + 60% + 8% of target's extra max HP) true damage. Attachment ends when the shield is exhausted or when leaping in the target direction to detach. She becomes untargetable and unable to use Basic Attacks while attached.
Attaching to a hero immediately reduces her active skills' CD by 30% and grants them these extra effects:
Skill 1: Soul tracking range increased by 20%.
Skill 2: Attack range increased by 20%.
Ultimate: Manually detaching reduces Ultimate's CD by 50%.
Deer Spirit Form: Slow aura's area of effect widened.

strategy.earlyGame: Yaria is an extremely ally-dependent support enchanter who attaches herself to teammates. Early on, help your mid laner's wave clear with Skill 2's auto-targeting magic. Then rotate with your jungler, secure the river crab, and head for ganks. Scout brushes with Skill 1 — its energy orb automatically homes in on hidden enemies and knocks them up.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, once you hit level 4 and learn your Ultimate, you can attach to an ally and grant them a huge true-damage-blocking shield. Identify your team's most fed player (usually the jungler or marksman) and become their personal guardian. While attached, the range of your Skill 1 and Skill 2 is extended.
strategy.lateGame: In late-game teamfights, your guaranteed shield is the difference between your carry getting one-shot and the enemy team getting wiped. Do not stay attached until the shield fully breaks — manually detach (hop off) before it shatters and your Ultimate's cooldown is drastically reduced.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, attach to your main carry. Spam Skill 2 for continuous magic damage and use Skill 1 to interrupt enemy casts or expose assassins. When the shield is about to break, hop off manually, deliberately eat a light CC to trigger your deer passive (invulnerability), then jump back onto your carry once the cooldown is up.

combos.title: Infinite Shield Loop
combos.description: Skill 3 (attach) -> Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3 (manually detach just before the shield breaks) -> wait briefly -> Skill 3 (re-attach). Exploit the manual-detach cooldown reduction to maximize your carry's shield uptime.

combos.title: Brush Scout & Neutralize
combos.description: Skill 1 (into brush) -> wait for the homing knock-up -> Skill 3 (attach to your engaging ally). Safely confirm the ambush, then instantly provide a shield to the teammate diving onto the exposed target.

strategy.commonMistakes: Letting enemy damage fully break your Ultimate's shield, incurring a punishingly long cooldown. Lingering too long in a teamfight in your fragile human form.

strengths: Her greatest strength is the ability to reliably protect allies while fighting, through Skill 3's attachment and shield. Even when hit by hard CC, she turns into a deer and becomes invulnerable, wasting the enemy's CC skills — giving her excellent survivability along with continuous vision control and disruption.
weaknesses: Her own damage and durability are very low, and she cannot function without allies nearby. Her deer transformation passive also only triggers once every 60 seconds, so getting hit by hard CC while it is on cooldown will often kill her outright — she must watch her positioning at all times.

synergy.reason: Strong CC locks enemies down, guaranteeing Yunzhongjun's dives onto the backline.
Provides shields and extra CC to increase Yunzhongjun's survivability and kill threat, aiding in safe disengages.

counters.reason: Targeted suppression CC can forcefully ground Yunzhongjun as he dives in while flying.
Guaranteed suppression CC perfectly locks down a diving Yunzhongjun, resulting in an easy kill.

passive.description: Cirrus recovers Breath when he leaves combat. When Breath is full, he takes flight, gaining Move Speed and the ability to ignore terrain.

skill1.description: Cirrus accelerates and charges forward, dealing Physical Damage and stunning the target.

skill2.description: Cirrus guides his feathers to counterattack, dealing Physical Damage and recovering Breath.

skill3.description: Cirrus shoots into the air, becoming untargetable, then strikes down, dealing Physical Damage and knocking up enemies.

strategy.earlyGame: Cirrus is a unique jungle assassin who can fly over all terrain. Abuse this passive to take thoroughly unpredictable jungle routes. His bleed passive makes him nearly unbeatable in early 1v1 duels, so invade the enemy jungle relentlessly from level 1. Keep landing attacks to maintain your breath (energy) and stay airborne.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, you dictate the pace. Ignore walls and flank from angles the enemy cannot ward. Dive-bomb priority targets with Skill 1, then follow up with basic attacks to shred their defense and stack lethal bleeds. Even if enemies Flash away, the bleed damage often finishes them off.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game he is extremely fragile, making teamfights difficult. He only functions as a suicide diver or a cleanup crew. Wait for the enemy tanks to burn their CC, fly over a wall straight onto the enemy marksman, and burst them. Then use your Ultimate's untargetability to secure the kill or stall until your team arrives.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, never enter from the front. Hover on a wall outside of vision. Dive onto the carry with Skill 1 and spam basic attacks to stack bleeds. The instant the enemy team turns their focus on you, activate your Ultimate to become untargetable while raining down feathers.

combos.title: Death From Above
combos.description: Skill 1 (hold & release) -> basic attack (x4) -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3. Dive-bomb to stun your target, quickly stack four bleeds with basic attacks, deflect retaliation with Skill 2, then use your Ultimate to dodge enemy peel and lock in the kill.

combos.title: Untargetable Escape
combos.description: Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 3 (over a wall). Dive a target near a wall for instant burst, then immediately use your Ultimate's untargetability and movement to glide safely to the other side of the wall.

strategy.commonMistakes: Running out of breath before the fight starts and walking on the ground, losing your terrain-ignoring passive. Engaging first and getting CC'd and instantly killed before you can use your untargetable Ultimate.

strengths: He can completely ignore terrain, enabling surprise attacks and escapes from unpredictable routes. His passive deals percentage damage based on max HP, so he can even hurt tanks, and with tools like Skill 3's invulnerability into AoE CC, he has exceptionally high potential as an assassin.
weaknesses: Once his flight state drops, his mobility craters and he loses most of his strengths. Skill 1's dive also places him behind his target, so a misjudged engage leaves him stranded in the middle of the enemy team eating focus fire — his timing windows for entry are extremely unforgiving.

synergy.reason: Stealth and group pulls make it incredibly easy to land Light Li Xin's massive AoE ultimate on multiple targets.
Healing and CC safely support Dark Li Xin's engages or Light Li Xin's poke.

counters.reason: Strong shields and knockbacks can easily stop Li Xin's burst damage and engage attempts.
Exceptional late-game dueling ability allows him to completely shut down Dark Li Xin's split push potential.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Ashen Razor
passive.description: Standard Form: Li Xin's Basic Attacks and Chaos Waves grant 10 EXP upon hitting a hero. Domination Form: Every 1% extra Attack Speed grants 0.15% Physical Pierce. Domination Energy boosts this effect by 50%-100% (scales with Domination Energy). Revenge Form: Every 1.5 extra Physical Attack grants 0.1% Movement Speed. Revenge Energy boosts this effect by 50%-100% (scales with Revenge Energy). Upon transforming from Standard Form to Domination or Revenge Form, Li Xin gains maximum Domination or Revenge Energy (up to the limit of 100). Maintaining the transformation consumes 10 of the respective Energy per second. When transforming between Forms, Li Xin loses all Energy from the current Form and gains (100 - current Energy) Energy for the new Form.

forms.description: Standard Form: Li Xin's Basic Attacks and Chaos Waves grant 10 EXP upon hitting a hero. Domination Form: Every 1% extra Attack Speed grants 0.15% Physical Pierce. Domination Energy boosts this effect by 50%-100% (scales with Domination Energy). Revenge Form: Every 1.5 extra Physical Attack grants 0.1% Movement Speed. Revenge Energy boosts this effect by 50%-100% (scales with Revenge Energy). Upon transforming from Standard Form to Domination or Revenge Form, Li Xin gains maximum Domination or Revenge Energy (up to the limit of 100). Maintaining the transformation consumes 10 of the respective Energy per second. When transforming between Forms, Li Xin loses all Energy from the current Form and gains (100 - current Energy) Energy for the new Form.

Li Xin gains 20 Movement Speed. After each Basic Attack, his shadow performs an extra Basic Attack, dealing 75 (75 + 24% extra physical damage). Domination Form: Every 1% extra Attack Speed grants 0.15% Physical Pierce. Domination Energy boosts this effect by 50%-100% (scales with Domination Energy). Revenge Form: Every 1.5 extra Physical Attack grants 0.1% Movement Speed. Revenge Energy boosts this effect by 50%-100% (scales with Revenge Energy).

After Li Xin uses a skill, he gains 1 enhanced Basic Attack with a piercing effect. The enhanced Basic Attack has increased range and deals 50% extra damage. Enhanced Basic Attacks and skill hits reduce all skill CD by 1s. Domination Form: Every 1% extra Attack Speed grants 0.15% Physical Pierce. Domination Energy boosts this effect by 50%-100% (scales with Domination Energy). Revenge Form: Every 1.5 extra Physical Attack grants 0.1% Movement Speed. Revenge Energy boosts this effect by 50%-100% (scales with Revenge Energy).

skill1.name: Skill 1: Lightning Dash
skill1.description: Li Xin dashes in the target direction.

forms.description: Li Xin dashes in the target direction.

Li Xin purifies slow effects and charges up for up to 3s, gaining crowd control immunity, 80 Movement Speed (diminishes over 2s after charging ends), and recovering 65 (65 + 1% extra Health) Health every 0.5s. While charging, Li Xin automatically uses Basic Attacks, each of which deals 50% of their usual damage. 2 automatic Basic Attacks count as 1 standard Basic Attack. Charging for 1s grants 35% Attack Speed for 3s after charging ends. Each of Li Xin's Basic Attack hits reduce Righteous Fervor's CD by 1s.

Li Xin charges up, then dashes in the target direction, dealing 150 (150 + 50% extra physical damage) - 450 (450 + 150% extra physical damage) to enemies in his path, in addition to extra physical damage equal to 12% of the targets' lost Health. The damage maxes out after charging for 1s. While charging, he gains 25% damage reduction and crowd control immunity, and retains crowd control immunity until the dash ends. If charging is interrupted, 40% CD is refunded.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Chaos Wave
skill2.description: Li Xin unleashes sword energy in the target direction, dealing 450 (450 + 135% extra Physical Attack) physical damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 2s.

forms.description: Li Xin unleashes sword energy in the target direction, dealing 450 (450 + 135% extra physical damage) and slowing enemies by 25% for 2s.

Li Xin unleashes sword energy forward that deals 180 (180 + 55% extra physical damage) twice and slows enemies by 25% for 2s. It also gouges targets, causing subsequent Basic Attacks to deal 75 (75 + 24% extra physical damage) extra physical damage and restore 50 (50 + 0.8% extra Health) Health. The healing only applies against heroes.

Li Xin unleashes 4 bursts of sword energy in the target direction (burst interval is reduced as Attack Speed increases), each dealing 390 (390 + 130% extra physical damage) and restoring 120 (120 + 1.5% extra Health) Health.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Light Awakening
skill3.description: Li Xin instantly unleashes his anomalic power, switching to Domination Form and gaining maximum Domination Energy (up to the limit of 100). He consumes 10 Domination Energy per second.

forms.description: Li Xin instantly unleashes his anomalic power, switching to Domination Form and gaining maximum Domination Energy (up to the limit of 100). He consumes 10 Domination Energy per second.
Li Xin releases energy, creating a magic circle that explodes after a delay, dealing 700 (700 + 210% extra physical damage) and launching enemies within range for 0.75s.

Li Xin charges up (charge speed scales with Attack Speed) and unleashes 3 bursts of sword energy in the target direction, dealing 270 (270 + 90% extra physical damage) - 810 (810 + 270% extra physical damage). The damage maxes out after charging for 1s, and subsequent hits from multiple blasts deal 30% reduced damage. During the charge, he gains 25% damage reduction and crowd control immunity, and retains crowd control immunity until after the sword energy is unleashed. If the charge is interrupted, 40% CD is refunded.

skill4.name: Skill 4: Dark Awakening
skill4.description: Li Xin instantly unleashes vengeful power, switching to Revenge Form and gaining maximum Revenge Energy (up to the limit of 100). He consumes 10 Revenge Energy per second.

forms.description: Li Xin instantly unleashes vengeful power, switching to Revenge Form and gaining maximum Revenge Energy (up to the limit of 100). He consumes 10 Revenge Energy per second.

Li Xin suppresses the power of vengeance and switches to Domination Form (cannot be interrupted by crowd control). He gains (100 - current Revenge Energy) Domination Energy, loses all Revenge Energy, and deals 200 (200 + 60% extra physical damage) to nearby enemies.

Li Xin unleashes the power of vengeance and switches to Revenge Form (cannot be interrupted by crowd control). He gains (100 - current Domination Energy) Revenge Energy, loses all Domination Energy, and deals 200 (200 + 60% extra physical damage) to nearby enemies.

strategy.earlyGame: Li Xin is a Clash Lane fighter who is weak early but unlocks two completely different forms at level 4. Until level 4, play extremely safe: last-hit minions with Skill 2 and harass from range. Do not take fights. At level 4, choose between Light form, with its overwhelming AoE damage, or Dark form, which specializes in split pushing and 1v1s.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game — (Light form): position behind your frontline and charge your Ultimate (Skill 3) to fire three massive sword waves; you effectively function as a physical mage. (Dark form): ignore teamfights. Use your absurd movement speed and CC immunity (Skill 1) to split push mercilessly and raid the enemy jungle. Crush anyone who comes to stop you in a 1v1.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game — (Light form): you are perfect for defending high ground and sieging. A fully charged Ultimate clears super minions single-handedly and deletes half the enemy team's HP. (Dark form): you generate intense macro pressure. While the enemy contests the dragon, you can destroy an inhibitor tower in seconds. Split their attention.
strategy.teamfight: (Light form): stay safe in the back. Reposition with Skill 1, charge your Ultimate in a brush for an ambush, or release it when the enemy clumps up. Spam Skill 2's sword waves. (Dark form): avoid frontal teamfights. Flank around to assassinate the enemy marksman with your rapid basic attacks, or simply keep split pushing to drag enemies away from objectives.

combos.title: Light Form: Radiant Annihilation
combos.description: Skill 1 (dash & empower) -> Skill 3 (full charge) -> Skill 2 -> empowered basic attack. Take the ideal angle, unleash a fully charged Ultimate into the enemy team, follow up with Skill 2's four sword waves, then land a heavy basic attack.

combos.title: Dark Form: Shadow Execute
combos.description: Skill 1 (hold for speed/CC immunity) -> Skill 3 (AoE knock-up) -> Skill 2 (slash) -> basic attacks. Charge into the backline while immune to CC, launch them with your Ultimate, then shred your target with Skill 2 and rapid basic attacks.

strategy.commonMistakes: Teamfighting like a frontliner in Dark form and getting instantly killed. Releasing the Light form Ultimate without charging it, drastically reducing its damage and range. Feeding before you reach level 4.

strengths: His greatest strength is wielding two powerful forms: high damage reduction in Dominance mode and overwhelming attack speed in Berserk mode. While item-dependent, his passive grants him extremely high stats in both durability and damage, allowing for a flexible playstyle.
weaknesses: Each mode's powerful passive depends on energy that drains every second, so he risks running dry in extended fights or unexpected skirmishes. His base form is also extremely weak in combat, making his early game before leveling up a clear weak point.

synergy.reason: Her damage and healing buffs further enhance Garo's overwhelming range and firepower, making it easy to snowball.
His strong shields and peel potential can perfectly protect the immobile Garo from enemy assassins.

counters.reason: His high mobility allows him to bypass Garo's range, quickly closing the gap to deal burst damage.
His intense burst damage from stealth can instantly delete Garo, even if she has peel.

passive.description: Garo's Basic Attacks and skills deal 50% extra damage against shields.

skill1.description: Garo enchants her longbow, extending her attack interval by 25% but also increasing her attack range by 125. Every Basic Attack costs 50 Mana and deals an extra 32 (32 + 7% extra magical damage) magical damage every 0.5s for 2s. This skill can be used again to cancel the enchantment, increasing her Movement Speed by 20 and restoring her attack interval and range. Every Basic Attack restores 6 (5 + 1% physical damage) Mana on hit and an extra 200% Mana when the target is an enemy hero.

skill2.description: Garo shoots a piercing arrow in the target direction, dealing 300 (300 + 60% extra physical damage) magical damage to enemies in its path while silencing them for 0.5s and reducing their Movement Speed by 25% for 1s. After a delay of 1s, the area the arrow passed through explodes, dealing 600 (600 + 120% extra physical damage) magical damage to enemies within range. She casts the skill faster as she gains Attack Speed. Casting speed increases by 1% for every 1.5% Attack Speed, for a maximum increase of 100%.

skill3.description: Garo creates a magic circle in her current location for 8s. Using this skill again will destroy the magic circle. When she is in the circle, she gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Critical Rate. Upon destroying the magic circle, she gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Critical Rate if she is inside it, or half of these bonuses if she is outside it. Creating or destroying the magic circle will deal 380 (380 + 85% extra physical damage) magical damage to enemies within range. Passive: Critical hits from her Basic Attacks reduce the target's Movement Speed by 30% for 0.5s. If her Basic Attack lands a critical hit on the same target again within 1s, the Movement Speed reduction is increased to 50%.

strategy.earlyGame: Garo is a late-game Farm Lane hypercarry with the longest range in the game while Skill 1 is active. Early on, toggle Skill 1 on to poke from a safe distance, but watch your mana bar closely — it drains fast. Focus purely on farming and dodging ganks.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, once your core crit items start coming online, your passive shines: every critical hit applies a heavy slow to the target. Use Skill 1 to siege towers from beyond retaliation range. You have zero mobility or dash skills, so stay glued to your support or tank at all times.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you become an untouchable death turret. At full build, a single max-range crit applies a crippling slow, and enemies can never close the gap on you. Skill 2's silence is your best tool for shutting down enemy initiators. With perfect positioning, you melt the entire enemy team before anyone can lay a finger on you.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, deploy your Ultimate to boost crit rate for yourself and nearby allies. Toggle Skill 1 on and keep basic-attacking the closest threat from max range. When a diver approaches, throw Skill 2 to silence them, manually close your Ultimate for a burst of movement speed, and kite backwards.

combos.title: Infinite Kite
combos.description: Skill 3 (deploy) -> Skill 1 (toggle on) -> basic attacks -> Skill 3 (close for speed). Gain the crit buff from your Ultimate, keep landing long-range crits (heavy slows), and if enemies get too close, close your Ultimate to speed away.

combos.title: Interrupt & Execute
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 (toggle on) -> basic attacks. Fire the piercing arrow to silence a casting or engaging enemy, immediately switch to your long-range stance, and shoot them down while they are silenced and slowed.

strategy.commonMistakes: Leaving Skill 1 toggled on constantly, draining your mana and leaving you helpless when it matters. Overextending to chase kills and stepping out of your frontline's protection.

strengths: Her greatest strength is denying all enemy approaches through Skill 1's extreme range and the movement speed slow on critical hits, letting her kite endlessly. On top of that, her passive deals bonus damage equal to enemy shields, instantly neutralizing shield-reliant heroes.
weaknesses: While her longbow is deployed, her attack speed drops by 20%, and with no mobility skill she is extremely fragile when assassins reach her. Her mana costs are steep, and outside of the movement speed buff from dismissing Skill 3, she has no self-defense, so she dies easily without her team's protection.

synergy.reason: By clumping enemies up, he can maximize Sun Ce's strong AoE damage.
By refreshing his cooldowns, she allows him to unleash his powerful CC combo a second time.

counters.reason: His cleanse ability can completely negate Sun Ce's strong CC combos.
His high sustain and CC resistance allow him to simply face-tank the engage.

passive.description:
Every 6s, Sun Ce's next Basic Attack is enhanced, dealing an extra 209 (110 + 60% physical attack) physical damage and restoring 104 (55 + 30% physical attack + 3% lost Health) Health to him.
Whenever he receives physical damage or true damage or hits a target with a skill, he gains 1 stack of Undaunted, for up to 10 stacks. Each stack increases his Physical Defense by 16-32 for 6s.

skill1.description:
Sun Ce dashes in the target direction, dealing 199 (125 + 45% physical attack) physical damage to enemies in his path. At the end of the dash, he deals 399 (250 + 90% physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range.
After a short delay, he deals another strike of equal physical damage to enemies within range and launches them for 1s.

skill2.description:
Sun Ce strides forward and hacks at enemies within the target area, dealing 296 (180 + 70% physical attack) physical damage and placing 1 stack of slow on them. Each stack reduces the target's Movement Speed by 15% for 2s, for up to 3 stacks. He can use this skill 3 times before it enters cooldown, with each hack dealing 25% more physical damage than the previous one.
The cooldown of the Basic Attack is refreshed every time he uses this skill.

skill3.description:
Sun Ce gains crowd control immunity and pilots his ship forward for 12s. While moving, the ship accelerates continuously and knocks back enemy minions and non-ancient monsters in its path, dealing 549 (350 + 120% physical attack) physical damage to them.
He can disembark while moving by using the skill again. When the ship collides with a wall, structure, ancient monster, or enemy hero, or when the time is up, it will explode. The explosion deals 549 (350 + 120% physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and launches them for 1-1.5s (duration increases with time traveled).
He gains 5 stacks of Undaunted if the ship's explosion hits an enemy.
While he is piloting the ship, a nearby teammate can tap a button to embark. The teammate will disembark when they are hit by hard crowd control, when they use a movement skill, or when Sun Ce disembarks.

strategy.earlyGame: Sun Ce is a high-impact Clash Lane/jungle fighter with exceptional CC and global playmaking. In lane, trade aggressively with Skill 1 and Skill 2. His passive stacks physical defense every time he takes physical damage, making him rock-solid into AD matchups. Clear waves quickly and race to level 4.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, your Ultimate changes everything. Summon your ship to sail across the map, gaining complete immunity to all CC while steering. Use it to gank mid and the Farm Lane relentlessly. Ramming an enemy directly knocks them up, letting you instantly burst squishy targets. Coordinate with your jungler for overwhelming map pressure.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you are the main initiator. A perfect ship crash into the enemy backline can decide the game in an instant. The longer you sail, however, the harder the ship is to steer — plan your route carefully and avoid clipping terrain. If you miss the priority target, quickly hop off manually and join the fight.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, start from an unwarded jungle or side lane. Ultimate straight into the enemy team's squishiest member. On impact (or by hopping off just beforehand and letting the ship crash alone), immediately chain a second knock-up with Skill 1. Then weave basic attacks between Skill 2's three strikes to shred your target.

combos.title: Shipwreck Combo
combos.description: Skill 3 (sail) -> Skill 3 (hop off) -> Skill 1 -> Skill 2 (x3). Steer the ship, jump off just before impact so the ship lands the knock-up, immediately cast Skill 1 to chain a second knock-up, then land all three hits of Skill 2.

combos.title: Lane Bully Lockdown
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Flash -> Skill 2 (x3) -> basic attacks. Flash during Skill 1's cast animation to guarantee the knock-up on a distant enemy, then stick to them with Skill 2's slowing strikes.

strategy.commonMistakes: Crashing your ship into a wall before it ever reaches the teamfight. Sailing in solo from so far away that your team cannot follow up, wasting your powerful CC.

strengths: His greatest weapons are the map-wide mobility of Skill 3 and the powerful hard CC (knock-up) it delivers. His passive's physical defense stacking and HP regen, plus the ship's crowd control immunity, give him strong durability, and his ability to initiate with his whole team in tow is among the best in the game.
weaknesses: Steering Skill 3 takes practice, and hitting an obstacle wastes the skill entirely. He is also heavily skill-reliant: missing Skill 1 and Skill 3 costs him both his mobility and CC, leaving him easy to kite. Note also that right after an ambush, before his tenacity stacks build up, his defenses are on the low side.

synergy.reason: Pulling enemies together makes it much easier for Wan'er to land the AoE burst from her intersecting brush strokes.

counters.reason: His point-and-click suppression CC interrupts her dash, stopping her from taking flight.

passive.description: Shangguan's basic attacks gain enhanced range and deal extra magical damage after a short delay or when hitting an enemy with a skill. Her abilities leave behind ink marks that interact with each other to cause additional effects.

skill1.description: Shangguan throws a brush in a straight line, dealing magical damage to enemies in its path. The brush explodes at maximum range or upon hitting a hero, dealing area magical damage.

skill2.description: Shangguan writes on the ground, creating a zone of ink. Enemies in the zone take continuous magical damage and are slowed. If Brush Strike hits the ink, it triggers an explosion.

skill3.description: Shangguan dashes forward. If she hits an enemy or an ink mark, she can dash again up to 5 times. After completing 5 dashes, she leaps into the air, becoming untargetable and raining down ink bolts on nearby enemies, dealing massive magical damage.

strategy.earlyGame: Shangguan is an extremely high-skill-cap mid lane assassin mage. Before level 4 she is very vulnerable. Use Skill 1 and Skill 2 purely for wave clear and safe poke from a distance. When her brush strokes and ink blasts intersect, they trigger an AoE explosion that deals heavy damage and heals her.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, at level 4 her ability to solo tower-dive and assassinate targets comes online. Her Ultimate lets her dash five times (through her ink from Skill 1/2, or through enemies) to take flight, becoming untargetable while raining down devastating damage. Roam aggressively to the Farm Lane and execute the enemy marksman.
strategy.lateGame: Late-game teamfights demand extreme precision. Botch your Ultimate dashes and you will be stranded in the middle of the enemy team and instantly killed. Look for flanking angles, or wait for the enemy's lethal CC (suppression and the like) to be spent before starting your calligraphy dashes.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, stay back and poke with the Skill 2 -> Skill 1 ink explosion combo. Once a priority target drops below 70% HP, begin your Ultimate sequence, gliding through your own ink and the enemy frontline. Once airborne, position the joystick over the enemy carry so your ink barrage lands fully concentrated on them.

combos.title: Standard Takeoff (2-1-3-3-3-3-3)
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3 (dash forward 5 times). Throw the brush (Skill 2), immediately lay the ink blot (Skill 1) along the same path, then use your Ultimate to dash back and forth along your own ink trail five times and take flight.

combos.title: Step-Back Delayed Flight
combos.description: Skill 2 -> step back -> Skill 3 (dash forward twice) -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3 (dash forward 3 times). Throw Skill 2, back off to delay the timing, dash twice through the returning brush, then place Skill 1 and complete your remaining three dashes through the fresh ink. Extremely hard for enemies to predict.

strategy.commonMistakes: Fumbling the joystick and missing your ink or an enemy, breaking the Ultimate dash sequence, failing to take off, and dying a certain death. Dashing straight into hard CC (such as Donghuang's Ultimate) before liftoff.

strengths: Her greatest strength is the overwhelming sustained magic damage she deals from Skill 3's flight, which makes her untargetable and cleanses all CC. She is also highly mobile, and her passive's ink explosions and HP restore from skill combos give her both elite solo-kill potential and strong survivability as an assassin.
weaknesses: Skill 3 is extraordinarily difficult to execute, and without landing the dashes she produces neither meaningful damage nor survivability. She is also completely defenseless after her flight ends, so failing to finish off her targets — or eating hard CC mid-dash before going untargetable — leaves her dead with no recourse.

synergy.reason: He can dive in alongside Allain's ultimate to instantly burst down the enemy core.
Her shields and true damage strongly support Allain's survivability and damage output.

counters.reason: His point-and-click suppression completely shuts down Allain's combos and prevents him from becoming untargetable.

passive.description:
Allain's Basic Attack speed is very high. For each attack, he strikes once with each of his dual swords Crimson Shadow and Spirit Guardian, dealing 75 (22 + 30% AD) magical damage and 75 (22 + 30% AD) physical damage. Every first Basic Attack lets him dash to the target. Every third Basic Attack, he swings both swords at the same time, dealing 115 (36 + 45% AD) true damage and then entering a longer Basic Attack cooldown. When his Basic Attacks and skills hit enemy heroes, he gains Fury, increasing his Physical and Magical Pierce by up to 40% and damage reduction by up to 20%. Upon reaching max Fury, he recovers 168 (80 + 50% AD) Health, with a cooldown of 8s.
The lower his current Health, the more Health he recovers, for up to 3 times the base recovery.
His Physical Lifesteal takes 75% effect and applies to magical and true damage. His Basic Attacks only carry 60% of on-hit effects.

skill1.description:
Allain swipes upward, dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) magical damage, 177 (110 + 38% AD) physical damage twice, and launching targets directly in front of him for 0.75s. After the initial strikes of this skill, he performs different follow-up strikes depending on how many marks he has stacked.
1 Mark: Strikes twice more, the first strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) magical damage and the second strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) physical damage.
2 Marks: Increases the launch range and strikes another 2 times, the first strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) magical damage and the second strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) physical damage.
3 Marks: Increases the launch range and strikes another 2 times, the first strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) true damage and the second strike dealing 312 (180 + 75% AD) true damage.
He can move slowly and gains crowd control immunity while performing the strikes.
He gains stacks when his Ultimate and Basic Attacks hit enemies. Skill 1 can trigger 50% of the Basic Attack's on-hit effects, and can grant lifesteal and deal critical damage.

skill2.description:
Allain dashes in the target direction, dealing 144 (100 + 25% AD) physical damage and 144 (100 + 25% AD) magical damage to enemies in his path and reducing their Movement Speed by 15% for 1.5s. He also gains 10% Movement Speed for 3s, and his next 3 Basic Attacks gain 40% extra Attack Speed.
He stocks 1 charge of this skill every 10s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), for up to 2 charges.

skill3.description:
Allain selects a target hero and leaps into the air for 1.5s, during which he can move and is untargetable. He then smashes into the ground, dealing 254 (175 + 45% AD) physical damage and 254 (175 + 45% AD) magical damage to enemy heroes. The closer the heroes are to him, the more damage they take, for up to 100% extra damage. He gains marks and Fury for every enemy hero hit.
This skill produces different effects depending on whether the targeted hero is an enemy or a teammate. When he lands, he grants himself or the targeted teammate a shield that negates 627 (450 + 100% AD) damage. For every extra enemy hero hit, the shield's strength is increased by 1/3.

strategy.earlyGame: Allain's early game is about stacking his passive with basic attacks before committing to trades. Focus on wave control, and only use Skill 1 when your marks are fully stacked for maximum damage and healing. Until you hit level 4 and gain your Ultimate's untargetability, avoid forcing all-ins against strong early-game opponents.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, once your core items are complete, apply pressure through split pushing. Allain shines in skirmishes where his sustain lets him outlast multiple enemies. Join objective fights via teleport or flanks, and dive the enemy backline with your Ultimate to shatter their formation.
strategy.lateGame: Your late-game job is diving the enemy carries. Wait for their key CC skills to be spent, then commit through the opening. Your Ultimate matters not just as damage, but for dodging burst and buying cooldowns. Coordinate with your team so you are not left isolated when it ends.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, identify the enemy team's biggest threat and hunt them relentlessly. Close the gap with Skill 2 and snare your target. If you get low or draw focus fire, cast your Ultimate on a high-HP enemy or an allied tank to maximize your shield and shed the enemy's attention.

combos.title: Basic Trade Combo
combos.description: Basic attack (x3) -> Skill 1. Stack your passive marks with basic attacks first, then unleash a fully stacked Skill 1 for maximum damage and healing.

combos.title: All-In Assassination
combos.description: Skill 2 -> basic attack -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3. Dash in with Skill 2 to snare the target, follow up with attacks and Skill 1, then use Skill 3 to finish the kill or dodge the enemy's retaliation.

strategy.commonMistakes: Engaging without passive marks stacked, using your Ultimate too early in teamfights, and overestimating your early-game sustain against burst damage.

strengths: His greatest strength is dealing physical, magical, and true damage all at once, making him resilient against enemy defensive itemization. With fury-based penetration, damage reduction, and high lifesteal — plus Skill 3's untargetability and ally shielding — he boasts unmatched tenacity and damage in both duels and teamfights.
weaknesses: He must build fury and marks, so he only reaches full power by staying on top of enemies and landing hits continuously. If he gets kited persistently, he cannot maintain his stacks and both his durability and damage fall off. His basic attack on-hit effects also only apply at 60% effectiveness, so mind your item dependencies.

synergy.reason: His movement speed boost and healing heavily support the kiting needed to maintain the soul chain.

counters.reason: Her excessive mobility makes it easy to break the soul chain and kite away.

passive.description:
Augran's Basic Attacks vibrate his dagger-axe to resonate with an enemy's soul for 3s. The soul resonance deals 88 (50% physical attack) physical damage upon connection and will continue to deal damage with increasing frequency unless it is broken. When it ends, it deals a further 211 (70 + 80% physical attack) magical damage.
The soul resonance's initial and final damage carry 100% of the on-hit effect, while the rest carries 50%.

skill1.description:
Augran carves a path to the afterlife, dealing 280 (280 + 95% extra physical attack) magical damage to targets it hits.
The path accelerates after hitting walls or the Life-Death Border, then deals an additional 150 (150 + 60% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies hit. While on the path, Augran ignores terrain and gains 50% Movement Speed. The first time the path hits a wall, it creates an afterlife bridge. When Augran traverses the bridge, he gains a burst of Movement Speed, while nearby enemies are slowed by 15%.
Augran can use this skill again to recall his dagger-axe, entering the Seer State for 4s. If his Basic Attacks target an enemy with less than 10% Health (750-1,500 for monsters depending on hero level), Augran will instantly execute them.
This skill deals full contact damage to non-hero units. The dagger-axe will automatically be summoned back when the skill's cooldown ends.

skill2.description:
Augran swings his dagger-axe, dealing 200 (200 + 60% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies in front and slowing them by 25% for 1s. He then leaves behind a Life-Death Border, marking enemies who touch it. Enemies who touch the dead branches on the border also take 140 (140 + 45% extra physical attack) magical damage and are slowed by 25% for 1s.
Augran enhances his next Basic Attack, dealing 50% extra damage to the target and recovering 80 (80 + 1.5% extra Health) Health for himself. If there are marked enemies within range, the resonance applies the same extra damage and recovery effect for each marked target.
This skill also knocks back non-hero units. The resonance can link to up to 3 targets. When resonating with non-hero units, the recovery effect is only 50% effective.

skill3.description:
Augran channels his divine power and descends from the sky, dealing 380 (380 + 150% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back for 0.5s. If he hits an enemy hero, he recovers 750 (750 + 12% extra Health) Health and conjures their spirit counterparts to assist him for 8s.
After descending, he enters the Seer State for 8s. If his Basic Attacks hit a target with less than 10% Health (750-1,500 for monsters depending on hero level), they will deal a fatal blow instantly.
Every enemy hero hit increases recovery by 50%, up to a max increase of 100%. The conjured spirits inherit 30% of Augran's physical attack. They can only use Basic Attacks, but have higher Movement Speed and Attack Speed.

strategy.earlyGame: Augran should focus on efficient jungle clearing and staying healthy through his passive's sustain. Exploit his unique terrain-ignoring mechanics to deliver unexpected ganks on overextended lanes. Securing the early scuttle and building a gold lead is key.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, dominate the map with your mobility and sustain. Invade the enemy jungle with teammates and steal their resources. In skirmishes, overwhelm enemies with your sustained damage and healing. Constantly zone the enemy jungler and look to secure the dragon and the herald.
strategy.lateGame: His late-game sustained damage and execute potential make him an extremely dangerous threat. Depending on your team composition, decide whether to protect your carry or dive the enemy backline. Use your execute mechanics to swiftly delete low-HP targets and flip teamfights on their head.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, enter after the initial burst exchange. Position so your skills can hit multiple enemies. Tether the priority target for sustained damage and healing, and use your Ultimate strategically to finish off dying enemies or secure objectives.

combos.title: Ghost Gank Combo
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> basic attacks (tether). Phase through terrain with Skill 1 to close the distance, deal damage and bridge the gap with Skill 2, then maintain the basic attack tether to drain their health.

combos.title: Executioner's Verdict
combos.description: Skill 2 -> basic attacks -> Skill 3. Establish the tether with Skill 2 and attacks to wear down the enemy's health, then activate Skill 3 the instant they fall below the lethal threshold to execute them.

strategy.commonMistakes: Failing to maintain the tether connection during fights, mistiming the Ultimate's execute threshold, and overchasing without your team's support.

strengths: He boasts outstanding sustained combat power: continuous healing from his soul chain passive and Skill 2, high mobility from Skill 1's terrain-ignoring movement, and a percentage-HP execute in his shaman mode. Summoning spirits to fight by his side gives him strength in numbers, and his ability to attack and heal off multiple enemies at once makes him dominant in chaotic brawls.
weaknesses: His burst damage is low, and he depends on the soul chain's damage over time, so enemies who disengage quickly can deny his full damage. He also has to stay close to the enemy team to make use of his healing and execute, so if a strong CC chain locks him down, he goes down without accomplishing anything.

synergy.reason: His massive shields and proactive engage CC create a safe environment for him to output damage.

counters.reason: Her projectile negation and high mobility make it easy to avoid his burst damage.
Her physical damage immunity completely shuts down his damage output.

passive.description:
The elemental Dragon Souls from Ao'yin's last 2 skill attacks will be attached to his primary and secondary swords. He deals 165 (100%) physical damage with his primary sword, and if there are other enemies nearby he will also attack them with his secondary sword to deal 57 (35% - 70%) physical damage.
When using skills, he gains 1 Dragon Soul mark (up to 3 marks) and 1 enhanced Basic Attack. Using the enhanced Basic Attack expends all marks, unleashing Dragon Souls that attack the target (Each mark grants 1 extra attack, with subsequent hits dealing half damage). Effects vary depending on the type of Dragon Soul attached to his primary sword.
When switching between elements, Dragon Souls of the same element is prioritized.

skill1.description:
Ao'yin unleashes a wave of sword energy, gaining 1 extra Dragon Soul mark and dealing 270 (270 + 70% extra) physical damage and 70 (70 + 16% extra) true damage (and 50% splash damage behind the target) to up to 3 targets within range.
Use of Flaming Palm attaches 1 Fire Dragon Soul to his sword, allowing him to deal an extra 15 physical damage during Basic Attacks. If a Fire Dragon Soul is attached to both swords, he deals 50% more damage. If a Fire Dragon Soul is attached to his primary sword, the first strike of his enhanced Basic Attack will deal 97 (48 + 30%) true damage while the subsequent two strikes will deal an equal amount of physical damage.
Skill use speed scales with Attack Speed.

skill2.description:
Ao'yin unleashes sword energy, dealing 180 (180 + 45% extra) physical damage to up to 3 targets within range (dealing 50% splash damage behind the targets), and recovering 150 (150 + 2.5% extra) Health upon hit.
Use of Downpour attaches 1 Water Dragon Soul to his sword, allowing him to recover 18 Health and 0.5% Mana from Basic Attacks. If a Water Dragon Soul is attached to both swords, he recovers 50% more. If a Water Dragon Soul is attached to his primary sword, his enhanced Basic Attacks will deal 97 (48 + 30%) physical damage each strike, for a total of 3 strikes. Landing a hit on the enemy recovers 150 (150 + 2.5% extra) Health.
Recovery effects are halved against non-hero units. Skill use speed scales with Attack Speed.

skill3.description:
Ao'yin unleashes a wave of sword energy, gaining 30% Movement Speed (diminishes over time). He also deals 180 (180 + 45% extra) physical damage (with 50% splash damage) to up to 3 targets within range and knocks them back.
Use of Riding the Wind attaches 1 Wind Dragon Soul to his sword, granting him 16 Movement Speed. If a Wind Dragon Soul is attached to both swords, he gains an extra 50% Movement Speed. If a Wind Dragon Soul is attached to his primary sword, he will deal 97 (48 + 30%) physical damage and knock back the enemy with every strike of his enhanced Basic Attack, for a total of 3 strikes.
Skill use speed scales with Attack Speed.

skill4.description:
Ao'yin reveals his true white dragon form and soars into the sky for up to 4.5s, then dives forward. During this time, he is untargetable and ignores terrain, but cannot attack. He deals 400 (400 + 80% extra) physical damage to enemies in his path and slows them by 15%.
Upon landing, he deals the same amount of physical damage and applies Dread to nearby enemies for 1s. Targets afflicted with Dread will involuntarily move away from Ao'yin.
Ao'yin then unsheathes his True Dragon Sword, gaining 20% AS and 25 Attack Range, and the ability to attack up to two additional targets for 10s.
Ao'yin can switch his swords' elemental Dragon Souls while in flight.
Flight speed increases with his Ultimate's level.

strategy.earlyGame: Ao'yin needs careful early farming to reach his power spikes. Prioritize full jungle clears and only commit to ganks with a very high chance of success. Avoid skirmishing with strong early-game junglers; focus on scaling and securing safe objectives.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, once your core items are online, your burst damage and mobility improve dramatically. Hunt isolated targets rotating between lanes. Use your high mobility to control vision and project intense pressure across the whole map, forcing the enemy team to constantly track your position.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, Ao'yin becomes a lethal threat to the enemy backline. Lurk patiently on the edges of teamfights, waiting for the perfect moment when the enemy's CC and defensive skills have been spent. One clean flank can instantly delete the enemy marksman or mage.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, never initiate a frontal 5v5 yourself. Strike the enemy formation from the side and target their most vulnerable carry. Burst your target down quickly with your skills, then use your mobility to disengage before the enemy team can turn on you.

combos.title: Swift Assassination
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 3. Close the distance with Skill 2, deal burst damage with Skill 1 and empowered attacks, then use Skill 3 to finish the kill or retreat safely.

combos.title: Shadow Strike
combos.description: Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 2 -> basic attack. A skirmishing combo that weaves empowered attacks for maximum burst while darting in and out of the fight.

strategy.commonMistakes: Engaging first in teamfights, missing key skillshots and getting caught out with no energy, and not tracking the enemy team's defensive items.

strengths: His greatest strength is his versatility: he can switch between three elements — fire (damage and true damage), water (healing and durability), and wind (mobility and CC) — to answer any situation. His AoE skill damage and the rapid follow-up attacks from consuming marks give him high combat power in both duels and teamfights.
weaknesses: The order in which he uses skills drastically changes their effects, making him extremely demanding in both execution and decision-making. Mismanaging his elemental passive leaves him a jack of all trades and master of none, and with no defensive stat steroids, he becomes fragile whenever focus fire or CC outpaces his water element's healing.

synergy.reason: His strong CC reliably locks down the target, ensuring the ultimate's tether doesn't break.
Her high burst damage guarantees a kill on enemies the moment they exit the illusion.

counters.reason: Her multiple blinks allow her to instantly create distance and easily break the ultimate's tether.
His point-and-click suppression can interrupt his skill while he is channeling the ultimate.

passive.description: Haya carries up to 3 moon crystals. Using Crescent Wave or Wayward Rays consumes 1 moon crystal. Once all are used, the skills enter full cooldown, and she gains an enhanced Basic Attack that fires 3 extra orbs, each dealing 50 (50 + 10% magical damage) magical damage. Targets hit by Crescent Wave or Wayward Rays will be marked, and hitting them again will trigger different effects.

skill1.description:
Haya unleashes a beam of moonlight forward, dealing 350 (350 + 75% magical damage) magical damage.
If the beam triggers a mark, the target also takes 100 (100 + 22% magical damage) true damage.

skill2.description:
Haya unleashes 3 glazed orbs, the first dealing 120 (120 + 22% magical damage) magical damage, and the next 2 dealing 60 (60 + 11% magical damage) magical damage. She also gains a shield that negates 250 (250 + 40% magical damage) damage for 3s and gradually gains Movement Speed over the next 2s, maxing out at a 30% increase. If she hits marked enemies, they will be stunned for 0.5s.
Subsequent hits will only inflict 50% of the stun effect.

skill3.description:
Haya links to a hero for 1.5s, gaining 50% damage reduction. The link breaks if they move too far apart, refunding 75% of Moonscape Mirage's cooldown. If the link remains unbroken after 1.5s, both enter the mirage, granting her a shield that negates 300 (300 + 70% magical damage) damage.
While inside the mirage, her skill cooldowns are reduced by 50%. If she uses Moonscape Mirage again while inside the mirage, she moves 700 units away from the target.

strategy.earlyGame: Haya's early game revolves around controlling the lane alongside her marksman. Poke with your skills and control space so your carry can farm safely. Ward the river and be ready to counter-engage against enemy jungler ganks.
strategy.midGame: Roam with your jungler and mid laner to secure objectives and create plays. In mid-game skirmishes, your ability to provide shields and healing is crucial. Prioritize protecting your most fed teammate — usually the marksman or a carrying jungler.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, position firmly in the backline right next to your main carry. Your entire purpose is keeping them alive through the chaos of teamfights. Use your Ultimate to mitigate heavy burst damage and swing fights in your team's favor.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, dedicate yourself to peeling for your team. Do not chase low-HP enemies. Save your CC for the assassins diving your backline, and time your heals and shields to absorb the brunt of the enemy's engage.

combos.title: Guardian's Grace
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3. Shield an ally with Skill 2, stop approaching enemies with Skill 1, and the moment your ally's health drops low, burst-heal them back up with Skill 3.

combos.title: Peel & Punish
combos.description: Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 2. A defensive combo: disrupt the enemy dive with Skill 1, then immediately shield your carry to guarantee their survival.

strategy.commonMistakes: Overextending and getting caught, wasting key protective skills on full-health targets, and neglecting vision control around major objectives.

strengths: Her strengths are the powerful bonus effects — true damage and stuns — against marked enemies, plus strong self-defense from Skill 3's 50% damage reduction and shield. Through her mirage's cooldown reduction and spacing manipulation, she can toy with enemies while continuously spreading damage and CC.
weaknesses: To maximize her damage and CC, she has to work through stages — applying marks and consuming moon rings — so she struggles to produce instant burst. Maintaining Skill 3's link also demands difficult positioning, and if a highly mobile enemy breaks the link, she loses her defenses and becomes fragile.

synergy.reason: Clumping enemies up allows Yao to unleash all of his strong AoE damage at once.
His movement speed boost and healing further amplify Yao's core strengths of high mobility and sustain.

counters.reason: His point-and-click suppression locks down his mobility and bypasses his damage mitigation.
Likewise, his strong suppression entirely nullifies Yao's combos and evasiveness, resulting in a quick death.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Gift of the Stars
passive.description: Yao recovers 70 (+2% extra Health) Health when his skills hit an enemy unit, or half if they miss. Skill uses grant stacks of Star Power. At max stacks, enhances his next skill for 3s. Using the enhanced skill then enhances his next Basic Attack, letting him dash at the target and deal 100 (+30% extra physical damage).

skill1.name: Skill 1: Starlight Slice / Brilliance: Starlight Slice

forms.description: Yao spins quickly with his blade, dealing 380 (+120% extra physical damage) to nearby enemies.

Yao spins quickly with his blade, dealing 380 (+120% extra physical damage) to nearby enemies and enhancing his next Basic Attack. Star Power mimics this skill, increasing his Attack Speed by 40% when both he and the stars hit a unit.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Star Rush / Brilliance: Star Rush

forms.description: Yao moves quickly to the left, dealing 180 (+70% extra physical damage) to enemies in his path and slowing them by 25% for 1–2s.

Yao moves quickly to the right, dealing 180 (+70% extra physical damage) to enemies in his path, slowing them by 25% for 1–2s, and enhancing his next Basic Attack. Star Power will use this skill again from the left, launching units hit by both him and the stars for 0.75s.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Return to Dust / Brilliance: Return to Dust

forms.description: Yao returns to his location 2s ago (up to 600 units), removes all Star Reduction, and deals 420 (+140% extra physical damage) magical damage to enemies in his path and at the end point. Passive: 40% of damage taken is converted into Star Reduction, only taking effect after 2s.

forms.skill_name: Enhanced Ultimate: Brilliance: Return to Dust
forms.description: Yao returns to his location 2s ago (up to 600 units), removes all Star Reduction, deals 420 (+140% extra physical damage) magical damage to enemies in his path and at the end point, and enhances his next Basic Attack. Star Power mimics this skill, slowing units hit by both him and the stars by 25% for 2s. Passive: 40% of damage taken is converted into Star Reduction, only taking effect after 2s.

strategy.earlyGame: Yao excels at early trades built around his Star Power mechanic. Manage your energy bar carefully so you have empowered skills available for trades. Use your mobility to clear waves fast and secure scuttles. If you have lane priority, look for quick invades too.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, split push and rotate constantly. Yao's high mobility makes him extremely hard to catch, letting him pressure side lanes while still arriving in time for teamfights. Look for picks on isolated targets in the jungle.
strategy.lateGame: In late-game fights, Yao is a formation-breaking disruptor and assassin. Wait for the first engage, then use your empowered skills to dive the backline. Your Ultimate is the key to surviving burst damage and resetting cooldowns, making you a slippery, persistent threat.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, never dive first unless you have an overwhelming advantage. Weave in and out of the fight, using empowered skills to deal damage while mitigating what you take. Your goal is to harass and eliminate the enemy carries while staying unkillable through mobility and your Ultimate.

combos.title: Meteor Strike
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 2 (empowered) -> basic attack -> Skill 1. Dash in with Skill 2 to gain a star, immediately knock them up with the empowered Skill 2, weave a basic attack, and finish with Skill 1.

combos.title: Starlight Escape
