combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 3 -> Skill 3 (empowered). Deal damage with Skill 1, return to your previous position with Skill 3 while mitigating damage, then use the empowered Skill 3 for a heavy burst and another reposition.

strategy.commonMistakes: Mismanaging the Star Power bar, spending the Ultimate aggressively when you need it to survive, and getting completely locked down by chained CC.

strengths: His greatest strengths are the overwhelming tempo of his skill spam and the combos built on Star Power's empowered skills and dashes. With Star Split delaying incoming damage and Skill 3 rewinding his position to cancel it, he has a tricky survival kit that lets an assassin shrug off enemy attacks while dancing on the frontline.
weaknesses: His raw skill damage is not especially high, so failing to execute his combos fully leaves him lacking damage. Skill 3's position rewind is also fixed at exactly 2 seconds back, demanding sharp spatial awareness and making him extremely difficult to pilot. Under hard CC, his skills stall out and Star Split's stored damage will kill him.

synergy.reason: Gathering enemies allows Xi Shi to effectively chain her pull CC and AoE damage.
Xi Shi's pull can forcefully drag enemies right into Huang Zhong's massive attack range.

counters.reason: His AoE cleanse and CC immunity completely neutralize Xi Shi's pull CC.
His strong dive potential and silence allow him to close the gap and burst Xi Shi before she can pull him.

passive.description: Shi's skills deal more damage as the distance between herself and the enemy increases. For every 100 distance, the damage is increased by 5%, for up to 40%.

skill1.description:
Shi throws an artifact to the target location, dealing 120 (120 + 24% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in the area. Enemies are pulled toward the artifact, and 1 enemy is wrapped in Silk Imprint. The skill can be used again within 5s to pull that enemy a short distance while interrupting the enemy's skill use.
If the enemy is too far from Shi, they will not be affected. Silk Imprint deals double damage to non-hero units.

skill2.description:
Shi releases an energy orb that stops if it hits a monster. The energy orb attacks nearby enemies every 0.5s, dealing 160 (160 + 50% magical attack) magical damage. The first hit slows enemies by 15% for 1.5s. Subsequent hits on the same target only deal 25% damage.
The orb explodes after 2s, dealing 160 (160 + 33% magical attack) magical damage, and double damage to enemies at the center of the blast. The orb will move toward the target wrapped in Silk Imprint.

skill3.description: Shi enhances herself for 8s, gaining a greater field of vision and resetting Skill 2's cooldown. While enhanced, hitting an enemy with Skill 1 lets her manipulate their movements twice, and Skill 2's cooldown is reduced by 50%. She gains 50% Movement Speed for 0.5s when using this skill.

strategy.earlyGame: Shi should focus on fast wave clear and aggressive roaming. Use your long-range poke to chip down the enemy mid laner's health. At level 4, use your unique pull mechanic to drag enemies out of safety and coordinate with your jungler for guaranteed ganks.
strategy.midGame: Control the flow of skirmishes by manipulating enemy positioning. Look to catch a priority target with Skill 1 before objectives are contested. One clean pull converts into an instant kill and turns the ensuing objective fight into a 5v4.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, getting caught means instant death, so your pull scales terrifyingly well. Position safely behind your frontline and constantly fish for pulls on the enemy carries. Use your Ultimate to shorten your cooldowns and provide relentless CC.
strategy.teamfight: Focus on shattering the enemy formation. Either drag the enemy frontline away from your carries, or yank their damage dealers into your team's burst range. Your Ultimate lets you pull multiple times, so use it to create total chaos and dictate the pace of the fight.

combos.title: Irresistible Force
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 3 -> Skill 1 (pull) -> Skill 2 -> Skill 1 (pull). Land the initial tether, empower it with your Ultimate, drag the enemy into Skill 2's damage zone, then pull again so they can never escape.

combos.title: Quick Displacement
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 1 (pull). Throw out the damage zone, immediately land the tether, and drag the enemy straight into the center of the damage.

strategy.commonMistakes: Missing the initial pull skillshot, overextending to land a pull and getting caught yourself, and forgetting to activate your Ultimate for the empowered pulls.

synergy.reason: With him peeling on the frontline, it's easy to safely output sustained DPS from long range.
Her strong utility and healing create the perfect environment to continuously deal damage in teamfights.

counters.reason: She can close the gap with high mobility and use her high burst damage to delete immobile targets.
His high early-game pressure and mobility allow him to easily engage and deal heavy damage.

passive.description:
For every 5% increase in Attack Speed, gains 1% Cooldown Reduction. Gains 5 Anger upon Basic Attack and skill hits (10 upon critical hits). At max Anger, enters the Excited state.
Excited: Enhances all skills and reduces the cooldowns of Awesome Barrage and Heavy Shot by 25%-50% while recovering (0-3 + 1% physical attack) Health for every 1 surplus Anger.
When not gaining any Anger for 3s, Anger will begin to diminish over time.

skill1.description:
Uses the Apocalyptor to strafe continuously for 5s. Each bullet deals 96 (40 + 34% physical attack) physical damage. While strafing, he is slowed by 50. Enters cooldown after use.
Excited: Bullets have a piercing effect, dealing 50% damage to subsequent enemies. Firing speed is increased by 1% for every 2% Attack Speed, up to 100%.
Tap and hold to use. Damage can deal critical hits. Strafing can be paused temporarily to use other skills. Hits grant 5 Anger, while critical hits grant 10 Anger.
Every 2% Attack Speed increases skill casting speed by 1%.

skill2.description:
Shoots a heavy round in the target direction, dealing 200 (200 + 50% extra physical attack) physical damage to all enemies hit and slowing them by 25% for 2s. When the round hits an enemy or wall, or reaches its maximum range, it explodes and splits into 5 splinters that can ricochet off walls and deal 410 (410 + 100% extra physical attack) physical damage to the first enemy they hit.
Excited: The number of splinters increases from 5 to 9.
Gains 5 Anger every time rounds or splinters hit an enemy. If multiple splinters hit the same target within 1s, subsequent hits only deal 25% damage.

skill3.description:
Meng Ya scans the vicinity and marks the locations of enemies within range when they take damage from his teammates (up to 5 locations can be marked). When the scan is complete, he fires missiles that deal 450 (450 + 120% extra physical attack) physical damage. Subsequent hits on the same target deal 75% less damage and grant 10 Anger. He continues to fire up to 1 missile every second for 8s after the scan. 50% of the skill's cooldown is refunded if the skill is canceled or interrupted.
Excited: The minimum interval between subsequent missiles is reduced from 1s to 0.5s.
The skill button can be held down for up to 3s to expand the scan range. He gains 50% Movement Speed while scanning.

strategy.earlyGame: Meng Ya depends heavily on keeping his Fury gauge high to empower his skills. Focus on wave clear and constantly poking enemies with sustained fire. His early-game pressure is enormous, so use it to bully the enemy marksman and take the outer tower quickly.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, your teamfight presence is massive. Move with your support and rotate to objectives. Use your Ultimate to rain missiles from long range and cover your team's engages. Always aim to enter fights with a full Fury gauge for the healing and empowered damage.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, positioning is critical since you have no true dash. Set up behind your tanks and unleash a relentless barrage. The overwhelming AoE damage you produce can single-handedly melt the enemy team if left unchecked. Watch out for assassins on your flanks.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, activate your Ultimate early to start the area bombardment. Keep firing Skill 1 while moving to kite approaching enemies. The healing from your Fury state is your main survival tool, so keep dealing damage even as you fall back, and stay alive.

combos.title: Suppressive Fire
combos.description: Skill 3 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 1. Activate your Ultimate's area bombardment, fire Skill 2 at a wall so it bursts and slows, then strafe while spamming Skill 1 to shred the target.

combos.title: Corner Pressure
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1. In tight jungle corridors, exploit Skill 2's ricochet mechanic for heavy damage, then finish with Skill 1's sustained fire.

strategy.commonMistakes: Entering fights with zero Fury, standing still and basic-attacking instead of using the mobile Skill 1, and sloppy positioning against dive compositions.

strengths: His strengths are the major skill empowerments from his frenzied state and the strong sustained combat power from HP recovery when overcapped. Attack speed directly reduces his skill cooldowns and increases his fire rate, so despite being skill-reliant, he wastes none of his basic-attack stats. Skill 3's massive-range missile support also lets him provide powerful cover for his team's fights even from far away.
weaknesses: His skills underperform when his rage gauge is not charged, and his heavy dependence on the frenzied state is a weakness. Skill 1 slows his movement while firing, making enemy skills hard to dodge, and with no mobility skill to compensate, he struggles to escape once the fight closes in on him. Skill 3's missiles also depend on his allies' attacks, so he cannot reach full potential without team coordination.

synergy.reason: His strong CC locks down enemies, creating the perfect opening to guarantee the high-burst combo hits.
By disrupting the enemy formation and drawing aggro on the frontline, he creates a safe opportunity to dive the backline.

counters.reason: His silence prevents the spamming of mobility skills, completely locking them down.
Frequent long-range stuns prevent any engages, making it hard to utilize high mobility.

passive.description: When the enemy's Health drops below 30%, Lam will mark them as Prey. Lam's skills and Basic Attacks deal an extra 7.5-15% true damage to Prey.

skill1.description: Lam submerges himself for 3s and gains 40 Movement Speed for 3s. After the duration expires, he returns to normal and 50% of the CD is returned. If he uses this skill again while submerged, he will burst out of the water and dash in the target direction, dealing 300 (300 + 120% extra physical damage) to enemies in his path and slowing them by 25% for 1.5s.

skill2.description: Lam attacks nearby enemies and slices open their wounds, dealing 2 strikes of 235 (235 + 50% extra physical damage) and recovering 100 (100 + 1.5% extra Health) Health for every enemy hero hit (recovery is halved for non-hero units). He gains 1 mark when using the skill, and gains 1 additional mark every time a different enemy is hit, for up to 3 stacks. While he has a mark, his Basic Attack is enhanced, consuming 1 mark to dash and deal 197 (70 + 75% extra physical damage) while recovering 100 (100 + 1.5% extra Health) Health. Each follow-up attack reduces the cooldown of this skill by 10%-20%. When using this skill while submerged, he will dash in the target direction and reduce Skill 1's CD by 25%.

skill3.description: Lam throws his dagger in the target direction, slowing enemies in its path immensely for 0.5s. After a short delay Lam dashes toward the dagger, dealing 520 (520 + 180% extra physical damage) and dragging enemies in his path along with him. When using this skill while submerged, he will drag enemies to the dash destination, and Skill 1's CD will be reduced by 50%.

strategy.earlyGame: Lam excels at fast clears and early skirmishes around the river. Use his dive form to move quickly between neutral camps and lanes. His passive deals true damage to low-health enemies, making early ganks extremely lethal — hunt wounded, overextended targets.
strategy.midGame: Dominate the river and command the map with his incredible mobility. Lam thrives in chaotic teamfights where he can chain dashes between multiple targets. Assassinate the enemy jungler before objectives come down to a smite fight, and secure them cleanly.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, patience is key. Wait for the enemy team to burn their CC. Use your Ultimate to drag a key carry out of safety and into your team's formation. With his self-healing and cooldown resets, he becomes a nightmare unless locked down immediately.
strategy.teamfight: Avoid initiating yourself unless you have a perfect Ultimate angle to isolate a squishy target. Dance around the frontline with Skill 2, stacking marks and healing. Once the enemy backline is exposed or drops below the true damage threshold, dive in and execute them.

combos.title: Deep Sea Execution
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 3 -> Skill 2 -> basic attack spam. Dive with Skill 1 to close the distance, burst out with Skill 3 to drag the target back, gain marks with Skill 2, then spam basic attacks to dash through and execute them.

combos.title: Shark Dance
combos.description: Skill 2 -> basic attack (x2) -> Skill 1 (dive & resurface). Apply marks with Skill 2 in close combat, consume them with rapid dashes, then use Skill 1 to dodge enemy skills or confirm the kill.

strategy.commonMistakes: Diving 1v5 with no allied follow-up, missing your Ultimate and losing your positioning, and failing to use the basic attack reset after casting Skill 2.

synergy.reason: Her massive AoE CC stops enemies in their tracks, setting up a perfect engage to unleash skill combos.
They both share high mobility and burst damage, easily wiping out the enemy backline together.

counters.reason: His extreme sustain and CC interrupt combos and movement, making it impossible to secure the kill.
Her point-and-click stun and overwhelming burst damage pose a huge risk of getting deleted before ever getting close.

passive.description: Jing and her mirror image apply 2 different types of marks on enemies when they deal damage. If an enemy has both types of mark at the same time, the marks shatter, dealing physical damage equal to 4% of their lost Health and refreshing the cooldown of Reflective Assault and Shattered Illusions. This effect has a cooldown of 5s (2s during the Ultimate). The damage dealt and recovery provided by the mirror image is only 30% of her real body. The farther the image is from her real body, the greater the damage and recovery, up to 80% of the real body. The image only deals 10% of the real body's damage to towers.

skill1.description: Jing dashes in the target direction, dealing 200 (200 + 100% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies in her path and slowing them by 15% for 1.5s. Her next Basic Attack is enhanced to deal an extra strike of 50 (50 + 15% extra physical attack) physical damage. If no mirror image is present on the battlefield, one will be created for 2s, which dashes with her and replicates all of her actions except the Ultimate.

skill2.description: Jing deals 160 (160 + 85% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and gains a 50% Movement Speed boost that diminishes over 1s. Recovers 150 (150 + 2% extra max health) Health for the first enemy hit, and 25% of that value for each additional target hit. If no mirror image is present on the battlefield, one will be created for 2s, which attacks with her and replicates all of her actions except the Ultimate.

skill3.description: Jing and her mirror image switch locations. Stocks 1 charge every 10s, up to 4 charges.

skill4.description: Jing flies forward, pulling enemies along her path with her. When she stops, she opens a Mirror Vortex and immobilizes the enemies at its center for 1s. She and her mirror image then move to either side of the vortex's central axis. While the vortex is present, she recovers 17 (10 + 4% extra physical attack) Health for every 0.05s spent dashing with Dimensional Shift. She gains 1 charge of shift if she deals damage to an enemy. The Mirror Vortex lasts 10s, during which Jing gains 10% damage reduction, but it will disappear if she leaves before then. When the vortex is formed, 8 mirror fragments are generated along its border. When Jing or her mirror image deal damage to an enemy, the nearest mirror fragment will fly at the enemy, dealing 30 + 2% of the target's lost Health physical damage.

strategy.earlyGame: Jing demands precise mechanics to maximize her clear speed and gank potential. Focus on reaching level 4 quickly to unlock the Ultimate at the core of her playstyle. Use her mirror image mechanic to soak neutral monster damage, and scout brushes to stay healthy and prevent invades.
strategy.midGame: Jing is a dominant force in mid-game skirmishes. Look for picks in the enemy jungle and side lanes. Her glass shard passive generates enormous burst damage. Once you trap an enemy inside your Ultimate's mirror field, use rapid position swaps to outplay and execute them.
strategy.lateGame: Nobody matches her ability to instantly burst a carry and disengage. But diving recklessly into a late-game 5v5 is a death sentence. Wait on the flank, target the enemy marksman, deploy your Ultimate to isolate them, land your combo cleanly, then swap out to escape.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, patience and positioning are everything. Let your tank engage. Once the enemy's key defensive skills are on cooldown, dash into the backline, deploy your Ultimate's field, and exploit the rapid cooldown resets between your body and your mirror image to unleash an unavoidable storm of damage.

combos.title: Mirror Field Infinite Swap
combos.description: Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3 -> basic attack -> swap -> Skill 1 -> swap. Dash to apply marks, create the field with your Ultimate, then weave attacks while endlessly swapping positions with your clone to reset cooldowns.

combos.title: Mirror Execution
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 1 (reset) -> Skill 2. A quick burst without the Ultimate: dash through the enemy with Skill 1, hit them with the clone to shatter the mark and reset the cooldown, then dash again and finish with Skill 2.

strategy.commonMistakes: Mismanaging the mirror image cooldown reset mechanic, deploying your Ultimate in a bad spot and trapping yourself, and panicking mid-swap sequence.

strengths: Her greatest strengths are the overwhelming burst from her body and mirror image working together, and the skill cooldown resets from consuming marks. With execute damage that scales off the target's missing HP, she is exceptionally good at finishing kills. Skill 2's HP restore gives her staying power, and Skill 3's body-clone swap enables a shapeshifting playstyle — dealing damage while toying with enemies, then escaping cleanly.
weaknesses: Because she depends on cooldown resets, a mechanical mistake or an enemy dodge that denies her mark consumption leaves her suddenly defenseless. Skill 2 also slows her own movement while active, so poor play creates her own openings. She is fragile, and if enemies read her Skill 3 swap and land CC on it, her squishiness gets exposed and she dies in moments.

synergy.reason: His sustained healing greatly boosts combat endurance whether mounted or dismounted.
He provides a solid frontline and shields, peeling to ensure they can continue dealing damage from a safe distance.

counters.reason: His immense mobility allows him to easily invade the jungle and disrupt early-game farming.
He targets the vulnerable dismounted state, and his strong chase potential makes escape nearly impossible.

passive.description:
Agudo has an affinity with the monsters of the Gorge. When she's near a monster, Recovery will be replaced with Release (grants buffs).
Upon hitting enemies, Agudo's Basic Attacks will drop Seed Mines and absorb nearby mines: She can pick up mines to gain 3% Attack Speed and Movement Speed for 2.5s, for up to 6 stacks.
Enemies that come into contact with a mine will take 30 (30 + 10% extra physical damage).

skill1.description:
Agudo sows a field in the target area, creating an animal wonderland that provides Agudo and her animal companions with 15% Attack Speed and Movement Speed, while granting 40 (40 + 0.6% extra Health). Her animal companions will come to the field and fight alongside Agudo. Animal companions' stats scale with Agudo's hero level, while the chance of summoning more companions scales with skill level.
Animal companions gain additional Attack, Attack Speed, and Critical Rate based on 50% of Agudo's stats.

skill2.description:
Tumble, Furball!: Agudo rolls forward with Furball, gaining 40 Block and immunity to 1 hard crowd control while rolling. Also deals 240 (240 + 80% extra physical damage) to any enemies she hits and stuns them for 1/2s. If they hit a wall before the end of the roll, they'll ricochet up to 3 times, resetting the rolling distance while increasing the skill's effect by 25%. Agudo also enhances her next Basic Attack to shoot 3 Seed Mines and deal 60 (60 + 20% extra physical damage).
Tumble, Agudo!: Agudo rolls forward and enhances her next Basic Attack to shoot 3 Seed Mines and deal 60 (60 + 20% extra physical damage).

skill3.description:
While riding Furball: Agudo commands Furball to leap to the target location, dealing 460 (460 + 150% extra physical damage) to enemies and stunning them for 2/3s. After that, Furball will battle independently while inheriting 50% of Agudo's stats and 100% of her on-hit effects.
While not riding Furball: When Furball is defeated, it will enter recovery mode. It can rejoin the battle after its Health is fully restored.
She can call Furball back before the skill duration ends.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early game, his jungle passive 'Release (Smite)' lets him instantly collect neutral monsters at high speed without taking damage. Clear the red and blue buffs as fast as possible to reach level 4, stacking your passive to strengthen your summoned beasts while landing ganks on lanes.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, deploy Skill 1's healing and movement speed zone in teamfight areas to massively boost your team's staying power. Roll in with Skill 2's CC-immune tumble to absorb enemy fire, and demolish objectives like dragons and towers at high speed alongside your summoned beasts.
strategy.lateGame: In late-game teamfights, hurl your partner 'Pom-Pom' into the enemy team with your Ultimate, knocking up their backline marksmen and mages and collapsing their formation. The main body (Agudo) attacks safely from range — and if things go wrong, recast the Ultimate to recall Pom-Pom, merge, and survive with the shield.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, place Skill 1's zone at your team's feet to create a favorable battleground, then throw Pom-Pom into the enemy carries with your Ultimate for a long knock-up. Agudo himself shifts to ranged attacks, bringing down the enemy carries together with his summoned wild animals.
strategy.commonMistakes: Taking damage while charging the 'Release' passive cancels it, so watch for enemy jungler invades. Also, after throwing Pom-Pom with the Ultimate, the main body (Agudo) is extremely fragile — mind your positioning and recall Pom-Pom immediately with the Ultimate if you start taking hits.

combos.title: [Fast Jungle Clear Combo] Smite (Release) -> Skill 2 (charged roll)
combos.description: Approach a neutral monster and activate Smite (Release) to collect it instantly with no damage taken. Then use Skill 2's charged roll to speed to the next camp.

combos.title: [Ultimate Engage & Zone Combo] Skill 1 -> Skill 3 (Ultimate throw) -> basic attack spam -> Skill 3 (recall Pom-Pom)
combos.description: Deploy Skill 1's healing and movement speed zone at your team's feet, then hurl Pom-Pom into the enemy carries with your Ultimate to launch them. The main body follows up with basic attacks from safety, and if you take damage, recast the Ultimate to recall and merge with Pom-Pom.

strengths: His unique system of releasing monsters instead of killing them enables a safe, unconventional jungle route. With Skill 1's powerful AoE buffs and healing for allies, and an army of summoned monsters fighting alongside him, his push power and teamfight control are outstanding. Pom-Pom's long-range AoE stun from Skill 3 is a strong initiation tool, and Skill 2's CC immunity and bouncing roll provide both mobility and disruption.
weaknesses: After detaching Pom-Pom with Skill 3, the mountain child (main body) has low stats and is extremely vulnerable to assassins. If Pom-Pom gets destroyed, it takes time to return to the fight, leaving him severely weakened in the meantime. When he has not gathered enough jungle monsters, Skill 1's benefits are thin, and once the enemy seizes the game's tempo and invades his jungle, recovering becomes very difficult.

synergy.reason: Her sustained healing and peel drastically increase the survivability of immobile, high-DPS marksmen.
Her massive healing pushes the effective health of frontline tanks to the absolute limit.

counters.reason: His strong lockdown shuts down mobility, preventing them from using walls to escape.
His high burst damage carries the risk of being instantly deleted before recovery or escape skills can be used.

passive.description: Sakeer's basic attacks deal extra physical damage and heal him. When he casts a skill, he gains a stack of Blade Mark, up to 3 stacks. At 3 stacks, his next basic attack consumes all stacks to deal massive damage and heal himself.

skill1.description: Sakeer throws out two scimitars that swirl around him, dealing physical damage to enemies and slowing them down. If both scimitars hit the same target, it deals extra damage and applies a short slow.

skill2.description: Sakeer dashes forward and gains Attack Speed and Movement Speed. His next basic attack becomes a phantom strike, dealing extra damage and teleporting him slightly behind the target.

skill3.description: Sakeer unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing multiple instances of physical damage to all enemies in an area. During this skill, he becomes untargetable and immune to crowd control. Kills or assists reduce the cooldown of this skill.

strategy.earlyGame: Sakeer's early game relies on safe wave clear and chipping down opponents with long-range poke. Conserve mana and focus on farming toward your core items. Use Skill 2 to scout brushes and protect yourself from early enemy jungler ganks.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, once your first burst item is complete, look for opportunities to land your full combo on squishy targets. Stick with your team and provide powerful AoE damage in objective fights. Set up behind walls and ambush enemies with your full combo.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, a single full Sakeer combo instantly deletes anything that is not a tank. Patience is essential. Wait for the enemy team to clump up or misposition. Your Ultimate's enormous AoE damage can decisively flip a late-game teamfight.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, stay in the absolute backline. Wait for your initiator to lock enemies down, then unleash your skills into the brawl. Prioritize the enemy carries above all, and hold your escape skill in reserve for when assassins dive you.

combos.title: Obliteration Combo
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3. Catch the enemy with Skill 2's CC, follow up with Skill 1's burst, then immediately drop Skill 3 for unavoidable, devastating AoE damage.

combos.title: Safe Poke
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 2. The standard poke pattern for whittling down enemy health in lane without overextending.

strategy.commonMistakes: Overextending to land combos, wasting your Ultimate on tanks, and poor map awareness that lets enemies flank you easily.

strengths: His strength is a remarkably versatile support kit: ally healing, enemy damage, knock-ups, plus stealth detection and vision control. His passive and skill fireflies automatically home in on targets, providing reliable support. With Skill 2's brush-to-brush movement and Skill 3's brush summoning, he leverages the map's terrain for extremely high mobility, survivability, and area control in local fights.
weaknesses: To maximize his core Skill 1, he must slowly build 'Firefly Power' stacks, so he cannot fire off powerful skills back to back. Much of his mobility and utility depends on brushes, making him weak in open areas when Skill 3 is on cooldown and no brush is nearby. He is also vulnerable to instant burst and chained hard CC, and his heavy reliance on teammates is a clear weakness.

synergy.reason: Her strong CC locks down enemies, making it easy to stack the passive and chain combos.
By clumping multiple enemies together, he maximizes both the AoE damage and healing effects.

counters.reason: His silence forcefully interrupts skill combos, preventing the passive from stacking.
Her high mobility and kiting make it impossible to close the gap, allowing her to deal one-sided damage from afar.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Splash Light
passive.description: After a skill lands on an enemy, Charlotte enhances her next skill into an Additional Skill and gains 1 stack of [Seven-Star Sword] for 4s. At 3 stacks, her Basic Attack is enhanced to [Seven-Star Sword]. [Seven-Star Sword]: Charlotte locks onto an enemy and slashes 7 times, dealing Physical Damage and reducing their Move Speed. The final slash deals extra Physical Damage equal to 15% of the target's lost Health.

forms.description: Charlotte slashes a triangle, dealing Physical Damage. If it hits an enemy, she gains Move Speed.
Enhanced Skill: Charlotte slashes a triangle with increased speed, dealing physical damage and granting extra Movement Speed upon hitting an enemy.
Charlotte charges in the target direction, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in her path and recovering Health.
Enhanced Skill: Charlotte charges forward, dealing multiple physical strikes with reduced Cooldown and increased Health recovery.
Charlotte slashes enemies in a circle, dealing Physical Damage and reducing their Move Speed. During the skill, she gains Damage Reduction and Immunity to Crowd Control.
Enhanced Skill: Charlotte slashes enemies in a circle, knocking them up on the final hit, dealing physical damage, and granting Damage Reduction and CC Immunity.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early game, Charlotte's laning revolves around landing consecutive skills to build her passive. Focus on short in-and-out trades using her movement speed buff. Do not commit to extended fights until your Seven Nights Guardian aura is fully stacked and the true damage execute strike is ready.
strategy.midGame: At max cooldown reduction, you become a relentless duelist. Your constant damage reduction and self-healing make you unbeatable in 1v1s, so look for isolated fights in the side lanes. Shove waves quickly, then rotate to flank enemies in mid-game skirmishes.
strategy.lateGame: Her ability to shred tanks and assassinate carries is exceptional. Wait for your team's main engage, then dive the backline. Pay close attention to your skill accuracy: missing a skill breaks your combo and resets your passive — a fatal opening in late-game 5v5s.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, do not play frontline. Enter slightly late and hunt the enemy marksmen and mages. Chain your skills without pause to maintain the damage reduction and CC immunity during the Seven Nights Guardian animation. Stick to your target and execute anyone low on health.

combos.title: Seven Stars Execution
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3 -> empowered basic attack. Land Skill 1 for the speed boost, close the gap with Skill 2, knock them up with Skill 3 to complete your stacks, then unleash the empowered Seven Nights Guardian.

combos.title: Relentless Pursuit
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> empowered basic attack -> Skill 2. Exploit the cooldown reduction from consecutive hits to chain endless dashes and slows, trapping the enemy in a merciless string of strikes.

strategy.commonMistakes: Missing skillshots and breaking your passive combo, engaging without your passive stacks prepared, and building pure damage items instead of the bruiser items she needs.

strengths: Her greatest strengths are her flowing skill-chained combos and the percentage damage and damage reduction from her empowered basic attack, Splash Gradation. Her follow-up strike's attack speed debuff gives her an overwhelming edge against basic-attack-reliant heroes. With Skill 2's strong healing and Skill 3's crowd control immunity, she boasts elite sustained combat power and dueling — very hard to kill even deep in the enemy team.
weaknesses: She cannot perform without continuously landing her skills, giving her a high skill ceiling and a poor matchup against evasive or long-ranged enemies. Since she depends on skill combos, silences and similar effects that lock her casting leave her helpless. Additionally, her wound debuff is removed when the enemy basic-attacks, so its value diminishes against heavy single-hit heroes and mages.

best_synergy.reason: Synergizes team firepower with Kongming's frontline engage to guarantee teamfight victories.
Synergizes team firepower with Li Bai's frontline engage to guarantee teamfight victories.

strong_against.reason: Can exploit Luban No. 7's skill windows to close the gap and overwhelm him with point-blank combos.
Can exploit Xiao Qiao's skill windows to close the gap and overwhelm her with point-blank combos.

weak_against.reason: Gets poked down before engaging by Ganjiang & Moye's long-range kiting and true damage.
Gets poked down before engaging by Arli's long-range kiting and true damage.

synergy.reason: Synergizes team firepower with Kongming's frontline engage to guarantee teamfight victories.
Synergizes team firepower with Li Bai's frontline engage to guarantee teamfight victories.

passive.skill_name: Passive Skill: Wish of the Living
passive.description:
At close range, Devara's Basic Attacks become melee attacks that have shorter attack intervals and grant 1 stack of Thunder Resolve, for up to 6 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, Devara calls upon the power of thunder, gaining one extra basic skill use.
After using a basic skill, Devara gains an enhanced Basic Attack that deals an extra 85 (85 + 45% magical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and recovers 75 (75 + 1.2% extra max health) Health.
Ranged enhanced Basic Attacks deal 75% damage to non-target units and do not trigger on-hit effects.

skill1.description: Devara charges forward like lightning, dealing 240 (240 + 50% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in his path and gaining a shield that negates 360 (360 + 5.5% extra max health) damage for 2.5s.

skill2.description:
Devara unleashes a ball of lightning forward. Upon reaching its max range or colliding with an enemy, the lightning explodes after a short delay, knocking back enemies and dealing 240 (240 + 50% magical attack) magical damage.
The closer the unit is to Devara, the farther they are knocked back.

skill3.description:
Devara responds to an echo across millennia, rising into the air as he enters the Legacy Manifest state.
The transformation takes 1.5s, during which he ignores terrain and gains crowd control immunity and 30% movement speed. The golden staff at his back strikes nearby enemies in succession, prioritizing heroes. Each strike deals 100 (100 + 22% magical attack) magical damage, while also granting him 1 Thunder Resolve and a shield that negates 160 (160 + 2.5% extra max health) damage for 2s. Upon landing, he deals 200 (200 + 45% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies.
He remains transformed for 8s, during which the range of his enhanced Basic Attacks is increased, Basic Attacks grant 2 Thunder Resolve, and ranged Basic Attacks create chain lightning that bounces between multiple enemies, dealing 86 (50% physical attack) physical damage.

strategy.earlyGame: [Lane] Focus purely on farming in the early game and aim for level 4. Look to seize the initiative early and snowball.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, join small-scale teamfights and hunt for kills. Coordinate with your team to steadily extend your lead.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, stay grouped with your team and be careful not to get isolated. Any enemy caught in a lazy position gets focused down in an instant.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, target the carries in the backline. Coordinate your focus fire and take over the fight.
strategy.commonMistakes: Recklessly taking trades without passive stacks leaves you short on both damage and shields. Also beware of using the Ultimate's terrain-ignoring dive to charge in alone, beyond the reach of your team's support, and getting isolated.

synergy.reason: She controls enemies to create a guaranteed opening, setting up the perfect situation to dive and start combos.
Her shields and peel greatly increase survivability when diving deep into the enemy team.

counters.reason: With his own cleanse and stun, he can easily turn the fight and punish any dives.
Her high mobility allows her to kite away, dealing high burst damage to poke them down before they can even engage.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Spear Will - Sweeping Fire
passive.description: Ying is mentally linked with her spear, Sweeping Fire. Using skills grants 1 stack of Spear Will. Basic Attacks expend all Spear Will, use the corresponding Spear Will skill (Stalwart - Peacemaker, Zealous - Devastation, or Zenith - Wildfire), and reduce Moonslash and Cloudchaser Cooldown by 1.5s. Spear Will skills can crit and benefit from 50% of Attack Speed.

forms.description: Ying swings her spear upward, then slashes downward, executing 2 strikes that each deal 180 (+60% extra physical damage). The upward strike launches enemies for 0.5s.

Ying flourishes her spear and attacks repeatedly, gaining 25% Movement Speed for 1s, dealing 124 (55 + 40% extra physical damage) to enemies over 4 strikes, and gaining a shield that negates damage equal to 260 (+4.5% extra Health) for 2s. This skill is cast by using an enhanced Basic Attack at 1 stack of Spear Will.

Ying raises her spear and charges up, gaining up to 25% Movement Speed. After charging, she dashes forward and executes a horizontal sweep, dealing 180 (+60% extra physical damage) - 360 (+120% extra physical damage) to enemies and slowing them by 15% for 1s.

Ying strikes 3 times, dealing 129 (60 + 40% extra physical damage) with each of the first two strikes and restoring 90 (+1.3% extra Health) Health. The final strike deals 258 (120 + 80% extra physical damage) and restores 180 (+2.5% extra Health) Health. This skill is cast by using an enhanced Basic Attack at 2 stacks of Spear Will. The lower her Health, the greater the recovery effect (up to 2x).

Ying ignites Sweeping Fire's tip and dashes back and forth through the area before her. Each dash deals 180 (+60% extra physical damage) and launches enemies. Upon dashing to maximum range, she launches a flurry of stabs. Each stab deals 90 (+30% extra physical damage), for a total of 4 stabs. While using this skill, Ying gains crowd control immunity and 30% damage reduction. Upon activating the second phase of the skill, Roaring Sun, she sweeps forward with Sweeping Fire, leaving a trail of fire behind. The sweep deals 180 (+60% extra physical damage), and the trail of fire deals 50 (+16% extra physical damage) magical damage every 0.2s over 3s, for a total of 1 time. While Starburn is active, the second phase of the skill can be used to sweep the area around her, interrupting subsequent dashes, dealing 120 (+40% extra physical damage), and leaving a circular trail of fire behind for 3s.

Ying leaps into the air and charges up before unleashing a sweeping strike, dealing 333 (160 + 100% extra physical damage) to enemies in its path. The lower the target's Health, the greater the damage, up to a maximum of 666 (320 + 200% extra physical damage) when the target's Health is below 50%. This skill is cast by using an enhanced Basic Attack at 3 stacks of Spear Will. While airborne, Ying ignores terrain, gains 200% Movement Speed, and gains 10% damage reduction.

strategy.earlyGame: Ying's strength lies in her flexible spear passive techniques. Use the tier-1 passive's AoE damage and shield to clear the jungle efficiently. Her sustained damage and disruption can easily flip early 2v2 skirmishes, so look aggressively for counter-ganks.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, control the map with her excellent mobility and dueling power. Use the tier-2 passive to stick to priority targets and restore health. Secure objectives with your team, and use your Ultimate's huge CC to zone the enemy jungler away from the pit.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you are a powerful initiator and off-tank. Wait for the window to catch multiple enemies with your Ultimate. The tier-3 passive (True Intent) deals execute true damage, making it utterly lethal to low-health targets trying to escape.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, initiate with your Ultimate to break the enemy formation. Adapt your combos to the situation: use tier 1 for shields and AoE, tier 2 to stick to marksmen, and tier 3 to snipe dying targets. Stay in the thick of the brawl and soak pressure.

combos.title: True Intent Execution
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3 -> basic attack. Chain all three skills in rapid succession to max out your spear intent, then unleash the empowered basic attack for devastating execute true damage from range.

combos.title: Merciless Pursuit
combos.description: Skill 2 -> basic attack -> Skill 1 -> basic attack. Use the tier-2 passive's rapid flurry of thrusts to heal while closing distance, relentlessly sticking to high-mobility targets.

strategy.commonMistakes: Mashing buttons and triggering the wrong passive for the situation, whiffing your Ultimate entirely, and engaging too far from your team's support.

strengths: Her strength is the flexibility of her varied empowered basic attacks, which change based on how many skills she has used. Triggering an empowered attack reduces her skill cooldowns, giving her tremendous tempo and sustained combat power. With multiple knock-ups from Skill 1 and Skill 3, plus crowd control immunity and damage reduction during Skill 3, her teamfight initiation and survivability are both exceptional.
weaknesses: Managing multiple skill combos and resonance stacks is mandatory, making her extremely demanding to play — her performance is directly tied to player mastery. As a tempo-based fighter, her instant burst is somewhat lower than a true assassin's. Her teamfight impact also drops while her powerful Skill 3 is on cooldown, and if enemies dodge her skills or lock her down with strong CC before she casts it, she loses the persistence that defines her.

synergy.reason: She absorbs enemy aggro and CC in teamfights, creating an opening to safely join the fight.
By disrupting the frontline, she makes it easy to pick off isolated enemies or squishy backline targets.

counters.reason: His point-and-click hard CC guarantees lockdown, completely shutting down high mobility like wall-hopping.
His strong suppression stops any flank attempts in their tracks, leaving them vulnerable to get focused down by the enemy.

passive.description: Feyd can move freely on walls, where his Basic Attacks become ranged (and can be used while jumping). He gains the following while on top of a wall: Jade Carriage: Stocks Stepping on Jade uses 10% faster. View from Above: Gains 15% increased field of vision. Crowd Control Penalty: Crowd controls last 25% longer.

skill1.description: Feyd moves swiftly forward, dealing 360 (360 + 110% extra AD) physical damage to enemies in his path and launching them for 3/4s. At the same time, he gains 50% Attack Speed and enhances his next 3 Basic Attacks. Melee: Each attack deals 75 (75 + 20% extra AD) physical damage and restores 155 (155 + 1.5% extra HP) Health. Ranged: Each attack deals 50 (50 + 13% extra AD) physical damage and bounces to the nearest unit within range on hit.

skill2.description: When on the ground: Feyd leaps onto the target wall. The leap's range increases by 4% for each skill level. When on a wall: Feyd steps on jade, jumping to the target wall. Stocks 1 use of this skill every 10s, for up to 4 uses.

skill3.description: Feyd swings his jade blade in a horizontal sweep around him, dealing 270 (270 + 80% extra AD) physical damage. (If he's on a wall, he will dash to the target area, then slash.) He marks all hit enemies and activates the skill's second phase, Hardened Jade Strike. Hardened Jade Strike: Feyd slashes each marked target 4 times, causing the marks to shatter, dealing 160 (160 + 50% extra AD) physical damage that ignores untargetable states. If a target's Health falls below 1/8, they will be Jadeified and shatter, being defeated.

strategy.earlyGame: Feyd dominates the lane with overwhelming sustain and durability. Play aggressively, using your skills to clear waves while simultaneously harassing the enemy laner. Control the scuttles and establish deep vision in the enemy jungle.
strategy.midGame: Become your team's immovable frontline juggernaut. Force skirmishes around objectives and lock down priority targets with your CC. Absorb huge amounts of damage with your natural tankiness, creating space for your carries to deal damage safely.
strategy.lateGame: In late-game teamfights, you are an immovable obstacle. Position at the very front and soak the enemy's poke and engage skills. Use your Ultimate to thoroughly shatter the enemy formation and isolate their damage dealers.
strategy.teamfight: Charge straight into the enemy team and cause havoc. Your goal is to draw as much aggro and as many skills as possible. Stick to the enemy marksmen and mages and deny them the fight. Trust your durability and healing to carry you through.

combos.title: Vanguard Charge
combos.description: Skill 3 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> basic attack. Initiate with your Ultimate's heavy CC, deal damage with Skill 1, then apply Skill 2's slow to stick to fleeing targets.

combos.title: Bulwark Trade
combos.description: Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 2. A simple but highly effective laning combo: deal damage while mitigating retaliation, and out-sustain your opponent.

strategy.commonMistakes: Playing too passively during your strong early game, failing to peel for your carries when they need it, and diving in positions where your team cannot follow up.

synergy.reason: Providing shields, she extends the time Alessio can deal damage while airborne.
Clumping enemies up allows Alessio to maximize the AoE damage of his basic attacks.

counters.reason: With high mobility and burst damage, he can quickly delete targets before they have a chance to escape.
Her insane instantaneous burst damage can easily punish and disrupt Alessio's positioning.

passive.description: Alessio's Basic Attack fires a shell that deals area damage, plus extra physical damage equal to 0.5% of the target's max Health. While he is grounded, the shell can be blocked by enemy heroes.

skill1.description: Alessio enhances his next 3 Basic Attacks to use upgraded shells, which have a greater area of effect and deal 180 (180 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage and extra physical damage equal to 1% of the target's max Health.

skill2.description: Alessio throws a smoke bomb, creating a smoke cloud that grants stealth to himself and his teammates for 3.5s. The bomb's explosion sends him into the air, granting him Movement Speed for 0.8s. While airborne, he can move and use Basic Attacks and skills while ignoring terrain. Using Basic Attacks or the Ultimate while airborne causes him to stay airborne longer. While airborne, Skill 2 will not throw smoke bombs, and Basic Attacks cannot be blocked by enemies.

skill3.description: Alessio leaps into the air, gaining brief crowd control immunity, then locks onto an enemy hero and fires 5 shells at them, with each shell dealing 350 (350 + 80% extra physical attack) (+6% of target's lost Health) physical damage to enemies within the explosion's range. If the same target is hit by multiple shells, subsequent shells only deal 25% damage. Only 1 shell can be diverted to another enemy hero other than the locked-on target.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early game, Alessio's laning is about safe farming and explosive trades. Use your range advantage and splash damage to push waves and poke enemies hiding behind their minions. Use Skill 2's vertical mobility to dodge lethal skillshots and reposition defensively.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, move with your team and look for opportunities to unleash your enormous AoE damage. Your smokescreen is a key utility tool — use it to conceal yourself or allies during rotations and objective plays. Stay safe and farm toward your core critical items.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you are a high-value target with tremendous destructive power. Position with extreme care. When a teamfight erupts, use your aerial vantage point to rain damage down on clustered enemies. A well-placed Ultimate can wipe the enemy team in seconds.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, stay behind your frontline and deal splash damage with empowered basic attacks. When engaged upon, use Skill 2 to take to the air and negate ground-based CC, then fire your Ultimate from beyond their reach, raining missiles onto the main threats.

combos.title: Death From Above
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3 -> basic attack. Empower your attacks with Skill 1, fly up to safety with Skill 2, unleash your devastating Ultimate, then finish survivors with aerial basic attacks.

combos.title: Smoke & Mirrors
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> basic attack. Drop the smokescreen to enter stealth, activate your empowered attack, and fire punishing splash-damage rockets from the cover of the smoke.

strategy.commonMistakes: Using Skill 2 too aggressively and having no escape when flanked, misplacing the smokescreen, and getting caught by positioning errors before you can take off.

strengths: His basic attacks deal AoE damage with a max-HP percentage component, giving him strong damage even against tanks. Skill 2's smokescreen stealth and terrain-ignoring aerial movement grant outstanding survivability and positioning freedom. His aerial attacks bypass enemy body-blocking, letting him precisely target the enemy backline. With Skill 3's crowd control immunity and missing-HP-scaling missile barrage, he is also an excellent finisher.
weaknesses: Most of his mobility depends on flight, so with Skill 2 and Skill 3 on cooldown his ground game is fragile and escape becomes difficult. His grounded basic attacks are easily body-blocked by the enemy frontline, making it hard to focus damage onto his intended target. Additionally, Skill 3's missiles can be intercepted by other enemy heroes acting as shields, so in chaotic brawls he may fail to finish his chosen target.

synergy.reason: By engaging the teamfight and disrupting enemies, he creates a safe environment for Luara to output damage.
He acts as a durable frontline tank, peeling enemy assassins away from Luara.

counters.reason: Her high mobility allows her to bypass Luara's kiting and consistently deal damage.
His high burst damage can instantly delete Luara before she has a chance to scale.

passive.description: Luara's Basic Attacks unleash serpent blades to attack enemies, dealing physical damage. For every enemy hit, her Skill 1 CD is reduced by 0.15s. Serpent blades come with a 30% on-hit effect and grant vision of the enemy hit. Each serpent blade lasts 6s, and up to 2 serpent blades can be active at one time.

skill1.description: Luara gains a serpent blade that attacks the target continuously over 6s, dealing 74 (40 + 20% physical attack) physical damage each time. She also gains a 45% Movement Speed boost that diminishes over 2s and can quickly scale walls should she run into them during this time. The speed of her serpent blades increases along with her level, up to a maximum increase of 25%.

skill2.description: Luara summons the Fire Serpent at the target location. After a short delay, the Fire Serpent charges at her, dealing 320 (320 + 80% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 25% for 2s. If she has active serpent blades, they will immediately strike the enemies hit by the Fire Serpent. If she doesn't have active serpent blades, her Skill 2's CD will be reduced by 50% instead. The cast point animation of this skill speeds up with her Attack Speed.

skill3.description: Luara summons the Fire Serpent in the target direction, dealing 480 (480 + 120% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies along the way and blinding them for 2s. She immediately gains 1 serpent blade and enhances herself for 6s. Attacking enemies or taking damage during this period accumulates Fury. At max Fury, she deals 240 (240 + 60% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and launches them for 0.5s. Blinded enemies cannot deal damage with Basic Attacks, and their skill projectiles will randomly deviate from their usual trajectories.

strategy.earlyGame: Your damage is lacking early, so prioritize farming safely under tower above all else. Clear waves quickly with Skill 1, and absolutely avoid reckless trades until you learn your Ultimate.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, once your items start coming together, your crits and high damage let you overpower enemies. Group with your team for fights around objectives, pick up kills, and accelerate your snowball hard.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you become the ultimate late-game carry, crushing everything you touch. Take extreme care not to get caught by enemy assassins, and overwhelm the enemy with a rain of crits from safety.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, never overextend — melt the enemy frontline reliably from behind your tanks. Use your Ultimate and skill combos for instant burst, and collapse the enemy formation from the back.

combos.title: Basic Harass Combo
combos.description: Send out waves with Skill 1 to zone enemies, then use Skill 2 for healing and bonus effects.

combos.title: Ultimate Reset Combo
combos.description: Use your Ultimate to reset the cooldowns of your own or your allies' key skills, gaining the upper hand in teamfights.

strengths: Her strengths are the auto-tracking sustained damage and vision from her crescent blades, plus a slippery playstyle built on Skill 1's mobility. Her greatest weapon is Skill 3's blind effect: nullifying enemy basic attack damage and deflecting their skills makes her an overwhelming counter to certain marksmen and mages. In her Skill 3 empowered state, the energy-charged AoE knock-up — offense and defense in one — gives her enough control to single-handedly disrupt a teamfight.
weaknesses: She lacks instant burst damage, so she cannot play like an assassin who deletes an enemy's HP in one rotation. To get full value from the empowered state's knock-up, she must also stay near the enemy team at the risk of taking hits herself, and without durability items or allied backup she can be burst down instantly. When the enemy composition has few heroes her blind actually counters, her core strength goes underutilized.

synergy.reason: She can chain her powerful AoE burst with the terrain and CC created by Ata.
It's easy for her to land skills and secure kills when Ata isolates and locks down enemies.

counters.reason: He can deal one-sided damage from long range, completely denying Ata's engage.
Her high mobility dodges Ata's skills, while her high armor penetration bursts down tanks instantly.

passive.skill_name: Passive Skill: Child of the Sea
passive.description: Ata's lost Health is stored in a buffer for 7s, and he recovers Health from the buffer equal to 40%/20% of the damage he deals to enemy heroes / non-hero units respectively (recovery is increased by 1%/0.5% for every 1,000 extra Max Health). After 7s, Ata's buffered Health will diminish by 3% Max Health per second. Basic Attacks deal 70 (70 + 35% extra physical damage) extra physical damage.

skill1.description: Ata leaps and slams his anchor into the ground, dealing 460 (460 + 13% extra Max Health) physical damage. He then bounces forward, dealing the same amount of physical damage and launching enemies within range for 0.5s. If he hits multiple enemies, the damage is reduced by 20% for each additional enemy, down to 60% of the initial damage. Deals 30% extra damage to minions. After the bounce, he rolls in the target direction. He gains crowd control immunity while using this skill.

skill2.description: Ata hurls his anchor in the target direction, dealing 225 (225 + 70% extra physical damage) to enemies in its path and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s. If the anchor hits a wall, Ata will pull himself and any enemies in his path to the wall and smash into it, dealing 250 (250 + 10% extra Max Health) physical damage and stunning any enemies smashed for 0.5s. Passive: Using Skill 2 enhances the next Basic Attack, pulling the target enemy to Ata.

skill3.description: Ata erects a high wall in a cone-shaped target area that blocks heroes and lasts for 4s. When erected, the wall deals 350 (350 + 120% extra physical damage) to enemies in front of him. While using the Ultimate, he gains crowd control immunity.

strategy.earlyGame: Roam the map aggressively from the start, using your powerful CC to convert your team's ganks. Force heavy-handed trades backed by your self-healing and durability, and keep constant pressure on the enemy jungler.
strategy.midGame: In mid-game skirmishes, be the first one into the enemy team, drawing their focus so your carries stay safe. Use your terrain-creating skills deftly to cut off enemy escape routes and secure guaranteed kills.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you are the key player in teamfights — split the enemy formation in two with your Ultimate's massive wall. Isolating the enemy carry and creating the perfect setup for your team to deal damage safely is your greatest job.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, dive in alongside your team's initiation and trap enemies in tight spaces with your skills and Ultimate. Hold the frontline with your overwhelming durability, soak all the enemy's attention, and carry your team to victory.

combos.title: Basic Wall-Slam Combo
combos.description: Hit terrain with Skill 2 to blink, damaging and stunning enemies in your path. Then follow up by bounding after them with Skill 1.

combos.title: Ultimate Split Combo
combos.description: Create a wall with your Ultimate to divide the enemy team or block their retreat. Then land Skill 2 off it for the stun and coordinate focus fire with your team.

strengths: His greatest strength is a passive that converts damage taken into healing through his attacks, giving him some of the most extraordinary durability and staying power of any hero. The crowd control immunity during Skill 1 and Skill 3 lets him move through enemy CC freely, making him an elite frontliner. On top of that, combining Skill 3's terrain creation with Skill 2's terrain-based stuns and pulls gives him powerful control tools for splitting and locking down the enemy team.
weaknesses: His durability depends on healing generated by dealing damage, so anti-heal items sharply reduce the tenacity that defines him. With low mobility and short range, he badly struggles against marksmen and mages who kite him from a distance. He also lacks burst damage, so killing even a single enemy takes time, and without his team's damage support he cannot fully carry out his role as a tank.

synergy.reason: She provides CC and strongly supports her high-mobility engages.
His cleanse greatly boosts her survivability when she dives into the enemy team.

counters.reason: With his own cleanse and stun, he easily shuts down her combo attempts.
His point-and-click stun completely locks down her mobility.

passive.description:
When attacking distant targets, Umbrosa's Basic Attack throws out a rebounding blade. She can only attack again once the blade returns. However, if she uses her Basic Attack just before the blade returns, it will instantly rebound forward for another strike.
While in ranged mode, every 1% Attack Speed increases her damage by 1.5. Each consecutive rebound of the blade further increases its damage and flight speed by 5%, stacking up to 3 times.
When attacking nearby targets, Umbrosa switches to melee mode. Her Basic Attack becomes a flurry of 3 rapid strikes, dealing a total of 110% physical damage.
Each Basic Attack applies a Mark to the enemy. Marked enemies take extra damage when hit by Feathered Tempest.

skill1.description:
Umbrosa sweeps the surrounding area, dealing 250 (250 + 80% extra physical attack) physical damage and slowing enemies by 15% for 2s.
She then enters the Frenzied state for 3s, during which she gains 25% Movement Speed that diminishes over time and 60% Attack Speed.

skill2.description:
Umbrosa dashes forward, knocking back enemies in her path (not considered a crowd control effect) and dealing 150 (150 + 50% extra physical attack) physical damage. At the same time, she triggers the Featherblade marks of all hit targets and spreads them to nearby enemies.
If there are enemies ahead, Umbrosa performs a graceful dance, throwing flying blades that strike 8 times, each dealing 110 (110 + 38% extra physical attack) physical damage and recovering 45 (45 + 0.8% extra Health) Health (healing is halved when hitting non-hero units). If Umbrosa is in the Indomitable state, the final strike deals an extra 100% damage. Each hit consumes 1 stack of the target's marks, dealing an extra 40 (40 + 15% extra physical attack) physical damage.
She can move freely while dancing, and using the skill again will cancel its effects. If the dance is not triggered, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 60% of the original.

skill3.description:
Umbrosa reignites her former glory as an Austren, dealing 400 (400 + 140% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies while gaining 50% temporary Health and 50% Movement Speed that diminishes over time. She also enters the Indomitable state for 4s. Any recovery effects will be tallied only after the state ends.
If Umbrosa is defeated while this skill is not on cooldown, she will resurrect after a short delay. Upon resurrecting, she will deal 400 (400 + 140% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies, and this skill will enter cooldown.
Passive: When leveling up this skill, Feathered Tempest gains an additional 2 strikes of damage, while her melee Basic Attack gains an additional 1 strike of damage. Additional strikes deal 50 physical damage each.
If her temporary Health is expended, she will immediately exit the Indomitable state. When she resurrects, she only gains 50% of the Health she would have gained if the skill were actively used.

strategy.earlyGame: Umbrosa excels at fast jungle clears and aggressive invades. Use her high mobility and early burst damage to terrorize the enemy jungler. Secure the river scuttles to build an early level lead, and constantly look for ganks on overextended lanes.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, you are the ultimate snowball hero. Dictate the map's pace by securing objectives and hunting isolated targets. Use your skills to dart in and out of skirmishes, applying pressure from every angle. Do not let the game stall — press your advantage and close it out early.
strategy.lateGame: Umbrosa falls off slightly in head-on 5v5s. Your role shifts to that of a pure flanker and backline threat. Wait for the chaotic moment in a teamfight, dive in to eliminate the enemy marksman or mage, and use your invulnerability mechanic to make it out alive.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, never engage first. Lurk in the fog of war. Once the enemy's key defensive skills are on cooldown, strike the backline with precision. Use your Ultimate strategically — either to dodge lethal damage or to lock down a key target for your team to follow up on.

combos.title: Lethal Precision
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3 -> basic attack. Dash in to close the gap, strike with Skill 1's huge burst, use your Ultimate to dodge retaliation and reposition, then finish with basic attacks.

combos.title: Hit & Run
combos.description: Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 2. A quick skirmishing pattern: deal heavy damage, then immediately dash out, forcing enemies to burn resources just to catch you.

strategy.commonMistakes: Engaging too early in late-game teamfights, mismanaging energy and botching combos, and falling behind in farm and losing the ability to snowball.

strengths: Her strengths are a unique basic attack that combines long-range poke with close-range burst, and Skill 2's ability to move and self-heal while attacking, letting her fight at multiple ranges. Her greatest weapon is Skill 3: a temporary massive durability boost (tenacity state) and an automatic on-death revival with AoE damage. This lets an assassin/fighter rampage through the enemy team like a tank — and come back as a threat even after being killed.
weaknesses: Her mechanics — the flying blade rebound on her passive, and choosing the right attack for each range — make her extremely demanding to play well. She depends on Skill 3's tenacity state and revival, so while it is on cooldown she is very fragile and struggles to join teamfights. She also suffers against enemies with enough burst to instantly delete Skill 3's temporary HP, or compositions that reliably chain CC onto her post-revival vulnerability window.

synergy.reason: She can reset his cooldowns, allowing Heino to cast his powerful ultimate back-to-back.
Combining her teleports with Heino's time-reversal ultimate makes returning to fights and regenerating effortless.

counters.reason: She can instantly close the gap and burst down Heino before he has a chance to heal.
His strong CC can lock down Heino, setting up a kill before he can ever use his ultimate.

passive.description:
Heino engages in combat in either melee or ranged mode as fate dictates. His skills and melee Basic Attacks mark enemies for 7s on hit.
Ranged: He channels the Power of Fate to attack distant enemies, dealing 165 (100% physical damage) physical damage and (15% magical damage) magical damage.
Melee: He brandishes his scepter to attack all nearby enemies, dealing 165 (100% physical damage) physical damage and (45% magical damage) magical damage.

skill1.description:
Heino reduces his cooldown by 0.2s for each marked enemy hit, up to 1s.
Ranged: He turns his scepter into energy and throws it, dealing 410 (410 + 75% magical damage) magical damage upon hit. He also throws 1 extra scepter at every marked enemy in front of him, dealing 75% damage.
Melee: He throws his scepter spinning, dealing 260 (260 + 45% magical damage) magical damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 15% for 2s. He recovers 150 (150 + 5% extra Health) Health for each target hit.
Ranged: When extra scepters hit the same target multiple times, subsequent hits only deal 50% of the initial damage. Melee: Recovers Health up to 3 times.

skill2.description:
Heino dashes forward. If there are no enemy heroes near the end of the dash, he goes into ranged mode. Otherwise, he goes into melee mode.
Ranged: Gains 15% Movement Speed for 2s. For each enemy hero near the starting point of the dash, his Movement Speed increases by 25%, up to 50%. If Skill 2 causes him to switch from melee to ranged mode, both the Movement Speed increase and its limit are doubled.
Melee: Gains 100 Physical and Magical Defense, and recovers 450 (450 + 12% extra Health) Health while increasing max Health by the same amount. For each enemy hero near the endpoint of the dash, his Health recovery increases by 25%, up to 50%. If Skill 2 causes him to switch from ranged to melee mode, both the Health recovery and its limit are doubled.

skill3.description:
Heino leaves behind a memory whenever he changes to ranged mode. He creates a field that grants 15% damage reduction and recovers 400 (400 + 6% extra Health) Health. During this time, he has crowd control immunity but cannot move. After a 1.5s delay, the field deals 400 (400 + 100% magical damage) magical damage and he returns to the memory he left behind. If there is an allied tower within the field, that tower returns to its state from 5s earlier.
The lower his Health, the more Health he recovers, up to 2 times the base value.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early game, Heino's playstyle depends on his lane. His ranged form excels at mid lane wave clear and safe poke, while his melee form provides sustain and dueling power in the Clash Lane. Focus on stacking marks and farming safely until you unlock your Ultimate.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, adapt to your team's needs. Either siege towers and poke from afar in ranged form, or switch to melee form and serve as a frontline bruiser in objective fights. Your Ultimate is an incredible safety net — play aggressively, knowing you can rewind time to escape danger.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, the flexibility of your two forms makes your movements unpredictable. In ranged form, you are a sustained damage threat; in melee form, a formation-breaking tank. Master your Ultimate's timing to make enemy Ultimates whiff, undo devastating damage, and flip decisive teamfights.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, read the situation. If your team needs damage, stay in ranged form and kite the frontline. If you lack a frontline, dive in melee form and soak pressure. Always leave your shadow mark in a safe spot so you can return home with your Ultimate the moment you take lethal damage.

combos.title: Time-Lapse Bait
combos.description: Melee form -> Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> absorb damage -> Ultimate (Skill 3). Dive in melee form to bait out enemy skills and soak heavy damage, then immediately activate your Ultimate to rewind time, restoring your health and returning to safety.

combos.title: Continuous Barrage
combos.description: Ranged form -> Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 1. Keep your distance, apply marks with the piercing projectile, and endlessly kite the enemy frontline while holding a safe position.

strategy.commonMistakes: Getting caught without a shadow mark placed, using your Ultimate too late and dying to burst, and stubbornly staying in the wrong form for the current teamfight.

strengths: His greatest strengths are the flexibility to freely switch between melee and ranged combat, and high survivability through self-healing. His melee attacks boost his durability with HP restore and max HP increases, while his ranged attacks deliver sustained damage from safety with bonus movement speed. Additionally, Skill 3's tower restoration effect and his escape to a safe position — with damage reduction and crowd control immunity — give him tactical advantages on both offense and defense that no other hero has.
weaknesses: His weakness is that dealing damage and healing both require applying and maintaining marks. He also cannot move while Skill 3's zone is deployed, so a poorly chosen location risks being surrounded and focus-fired. Moreover, his melee-form strength requires diving into the enemy team, making him vulnerable to CC — if he dies before activating Skill 3, his signature survivability never comes into play.

synergy.reason: He can easily follow up on Mayene's CC and knockups with his high burst damage to secure kills.
His long-range stuns are perfect for setting up Mayene's combos.

counters.reason: His reliable silence completely shuts down Mayene, who relies heavily on skill combos.
His unavoidable suppression can forcefully lock down the highly mobile Mayene.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Slack Off a Lil Bit
passive.description: Mayene's skills consume Punch Strength or Kick Strength. When idle and not taking damage, she sits down to slack off, accelerating Strength recovery by 25%. While slacking, she snacks on treats, randomly recovering 110 (+2% extra Health) x 1/1.5/2 Health. Attacking, taking damage, or moving interrupts this effect. She won't slack off in Serious State. Using a different skill combo within 3s of another boosts its effect by 25%.

forms.description: Mayene runs forward and pulls in enemies in front of her, dealing 300 (+100% extra physical damage) to enemies in a cone-shaped area and slowing them by 30% for 1s. Costs 1 Punch Strength. Recovers 1 Punch Strength every 8.5s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), max 2 bars.

Exploit Weakness: When using Whatever (I) again quickly after, she will leap into the air and deliver a powerful strike, dealing 400 (+125% extra physical damage) to enemies within range and extra physical damage equal to 10% of the target's Health, as well as launching them for 1s. Deals 50% extra damage to enemies in the center. Mayene takes 25% less damage while using the skill.

Feint to Retreat: Mayene delivers a smooth combo of strikes, starting with 3 punches that deal 200 (+70% extra physical damage) each, followed by a knee strike that deals 200 (+70% extra physical damage) while pushing the target backward slightly. She also recovers 200 (+5% extra Health) Health.

Mayene flips forward, during which she has crowd control immunity, gains 30% damage reduction and recovers 200 (+5% extra Health) Health. Costs 1 Kick Strength. Recovers 1 Kick Strength every 8.5s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), max 2 bars.

Flee Danger: When using Whatever (II) again quickly after, she delivers a flying kick to the enemy, dealing 500 (+150% extra physical damage) and recovering 200 (+5% extra Health) Health. She then somersaults into the air, gaining CC immunity, 25% damage reduction, and recovering 300 (+5% extra Health) Health.

Defend by Attacking: When using Whatever (I) quickly after, she blinks behind the enemy and delivers a spinning kick, knocking back the target and dealing 350 (+110% extra physical damage) (+15% target's lost Health) physical damage. If the target is defeated, recovers 300 (+5% extra Health) Health and 50% Strength (doubled for hero kills).

skill3.name: Skill 3: Get Serious
skill3.description: Mayene gets serious, dealing 360 (+100% extra physical damage) to nearby enemies. Upon entering the Serious State, she recovers 1 Punch Strength and Kick Strength, and max Strength is increased to 3 bars each. The Serious State lasts for 10s, during which she gains 15% Movement Speed, and any slowing effect inflicted on her is reduced by 50%.

strategy.earlyGame: Mayene is an absolute menace in early trades. Use her flexible 1-2 and 2-1 combos to out-trade and out-sustain any Clash Lane matchup. Her 1-1 combo's execute potential is unrivaled in the early game, so hunt for early kills aggressively.
strategy.midGame: Convert your lead into side lane dominance. Her high mobility and CC make her an excellent split pusher and an impossible target to pin down. In mid-game skirmishes, flank around the sides and use the 2-2 combo's invulnerability to wreak havoc on the enemy backline.
strategy.lateGame: In late-game teamfights, your Ultimate lets you chain multiple skills back to back. Depending on your team's needs, you can initiate, assassinate, or peel. Identify the most vulnerable carry, unleash your relentless martial arts flurry, and remove them from the fight.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, activate your Ultimate before engaging to enable your skill chains. Close the gap and knock up with Skill 1, then follow with Skill 2 to execute or gain invulnerability. Keep your martial arts combos unpredictable so the enemy team can never react.

combos.title: Lethal Execution
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 1. Her fundamental and strongest damage combo: dash forward to pull enemies in, then immediately deliver a ferocious flying kick that deals massive physical damage based on missing health.

combos.title: Evasive Strike
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 2. Her defensive outplay combo: roll forward with crowd control immunity and damage reduction, then follow with a flying kick that grants invulnerability and restores health.

strategy.commonMistakes: Mindlessly mashing buttons and producing the wrong combo, engaging late-game without your Ultimate available, and overestimating your resilience against hard CC.

strengths: Her greatest strengths are her overwhelming adaptability through diverse skill branches and her 1v1 combat power. She wields a wide array of tools: percentage damage, knock-ups, teleports behind targets, and knockbacks. Damage reduction and crowd control immunity during her skills, plus HP and stamina regeneration from her passive, give her both durability and sustained combat power. The stamina cap increase and slow resistance in her Serious Mode add tremendous explosive potential.
weaknesses: Her weakness is heavy dependence on her stamina gauge — once it runs dry, she can do nothing. Her many combo branches also demand elite player skill to instantly choose the right follow-up for each situation. Her passive's idle-state recovery is interrupted by moving or attacking, limiting its value in brawls, and the moment her 10-second Serious Mode expires, a well-timed punish can flip the fight completely against her.

577.name: Dyadia

synergy.reason: She heavily benefits from Dyadia's gold advantage, accelerating her power spike as a carry.
When an assassin dives the backline, she can use her ultimate to heal and peel from a safe distance.

counters.reason: His ambush from stealth can instantly delete her before she can even use her support skills.
Being locked down by hard CC completely neutralizes her ability to heal or support the team.

passive.description: Dyadia enhances her next Basic Attack every 7.5-6s (decreases with hero level): She swings toward the enemy, dealing 379 (210 + 100% physical damage + 30% magical damage) magical damage and knocking them back, then jumps back using the momentum. When a teammate receives Blessing of Fate (does not trigger at full Health; Gold halved if used on teammates with more than 50% Health), or an enemy hero is affected by Bitter Reconciliation, she earns an extra 20 Gold and reduces the preparation time of her enhanced Basic Attack by 50%.

skill1.description: Dyadia blesses a teammate with fated bond, restoring 200 (200 + 30% magical damage) Health. For the next 5s, heroes blessed with fated bond gain 30% Movement Speed when they move toward each other. When they come close, Blessing of Fate is triggered, restoring 400 (400 + 60% magical damage) Health to both and maintaining the Movement Speed boost for 2s. If she uses the skill again on a teammate already blessed with fated bond, she will dash to them and instantly trigger Blessing of Fate. The teammate recovers 400 (400 + 60% magical damage) Health and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2s, while Dyadia recovers 400 (400 + 60% magical damage + 8% extra Health) Health. She can use this skill again within 5s. If it is not used again, the cooldown will be reset.

skill2.description: Dyadia marks an enemy with a bitter bond, exposing them and dealing 45 (45 + 6% magical damage) magical damage while penalizing them with a loss of 2 Gold (does not affect non-hero units) every second for 5s.
