When the effect ends, it deals an extra 225 (225 + 30% magical damage) magical damage. When two enemies with bitter bond move toward each other, they are slowed by 25%. When they come close, Bitter Reconciliation is triggered, stopping them from taking more damage and returning the penalized Gold. If she uses the skill again on a target already affected by bitter bond, she will dash to them, triggering Bitter Reconciliation, immobilizing them for 0.75s and dealing a total of 600 (600 + 80% magical damage) magical damage. During this time, she takes 25% less damage (this effect is doubled against the affected target). The penalized Gold is held by Dyadia. If the target defeats/assists in defeating her, they will recover 100%/50% of the Gold respectively. She can use this skill again within 5s. If it is not used again, the cooldown will be reset.

skill3.description: Dyadia commands a swarm of wisps to fly forward, granting fated bond to teammates in their path, restoring 250 (250 + 40% magical damage) Health, and inflicting bitter bond on enemies in their path, dealing 320 (320 + 40% magical damage) magical damage. If a teammate already has fated bond, the duration is refreshed. They also recover an extra 150 (150 + 25% magical damage) Health and gain 30% Movement Speed for 2s. If an enemy already has bitter bond, the duration is refreshed. They also take an extra 200 (200 + 30% magical damage) magical damage and are immobilized for 1s. Passive: Each time Dyadia gains 1 extra Gold from using a skill, the base Health restored and magical damage dealt from Destined Encounter are increased by 1.

strategy.earlyGame: Dyadia is a highly aggressive roaming support. Do not stay glued to the Farm Lane — use her unique gold-stealing and CC mechanics to roam constantly with your jungler and convert early kills. Harass enemies to deny their farm and apply enormous pressure across the map.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, control vision around major objectives and keep hunting isolated targets. Her ability to steal gold from enemies and hand it to allies accelerates your carries' item spikes. Use your mobility to act as a deep ward and safely bait out enemy skills.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, her gold manipulation fades in impact, but her CC and team utility remain paramount. Stay with your carries and use your Ultimate to provide the massive AoE heal and shields. Winning teamfights hinges on timing your CC to shut down enemy assassins.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, hold position near the backline but stay ready to dart forward to land CC. Wait for enemies to dive in, then peel with your skills and firmly neutralize the threat. Save your Ultimate to reverse the fight when multiple allies drop low on health.

combos.title: Wealth Extraction
combos.description: Skill 1 -> basic attack -> Skill 2. Mark an enemy with Skill 1 to steal gold and apply a slow, weave a basic attack, then use Skill 2 to escape or further disrupt their positioning.

combos.title: Divine Protection
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 3 -> Skill 1. Dash into perfect position, immediately activate your Ultimate to shield and heal your whole team, then throw Skill 1 to punish the engaging enemies.

strategy.commonMistakes: Stealing farm from your own carry instead of the enemy, overextending and getting instantly killed, and forgetting to use your Ultimate defensively.

strengths: Her greatest strength is a unique scaling mechanic that endlessly empowers her by stealing gold from enemies. She also carries versatile utility: 'Good Fate' heals allies and boosts their mobility, while 'Ill Fate' reveals stealthed enemies, deals damage over time, and snares. In particular, the re-cast movement on Skill 1 and Skill 2 toward bonded targets, plus the knockback and backstep on her empowered basic attack, give her excellent self-defense and mobility.
weaknesses: Her weakness is that without low-HP allies or multiple enemies around, her 'Good Fate Blessing' and 'Ill Fate Reconciliation' rarely trigger naturally, so she cannot maximize her effects. Her strongest skill effects also require re-casting on targets already carrying a 'Fate' bond, so she is poorly suited to delivering instant burst or emergency healing. Dying is especially costly — enemies reclaim the gold she has collected — making her deaths a clear liability.

581.name: Flowborn (Tank)

synergy.reason: Acts as a frontline meatshield to peel for low-mobility marksmen against enemy dives.
Locks down multiple enemies with strong CC, allowing the mage to safely unleash massive AoE damage.

counters.reason: Can completely ignore the tank's high survivability with armor penetration and percentage-based damage.
Possesses true damage that ignores shields and physical defense, making it impossible to tank.

passive.description: Flowborn can draw the Flow into their body at the Base to enhance stats. Vitality: Increases max Health by 300 and Physical and Magical Defense by 50. Piercing Heart: Increases max Health by 300 and Physical Attack by 30. Haste: Increases max Health by 300 and Movement Speed by 3.5%. Focus: Increases max Health by 300 and Cooldown Reduction by 5%. Spend 1 stack of Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack that deals 408 (220 + 100% AD + 4% extra max Health) physical damage and recover 125 (125 + 2.5% extra max Health) Health.

skill1.description: Flowborn channels the Flow, reducing the cooldown of other skills by 50% while gaining 5 stacks of Flow and recovering 150 (150 + 4% extra max Health) Health. Gains 1 extra stack and recovers extra Health for every teammate and every 2 minions nearby, for up to 9 stacks and double the recovery. Flowborn deals 100 (100 + 2% extra max Health) physical damage to nearby enemies and knocks them back (without applying crowd control).

skill2.description: Flowborn charges toward the target, knocking back enemies in the path, then slashes forward to deal 600 (600 + 185% extra AD) physical damage and gain a 350 (350 + 7% extra max Health) shield for 3s. Using this skill continuously on the same target for 1.5s changes its effects in the following order. Clearing Slash: Deals equal slash damage to enemies, launches them for 0.33s, and gains a shield of the same amount. Rifting Slash: Deals equal slash damage to enemies, launches them for 0.66s, and gains a shield of the same amount. If the skill is not on cooldown, spend 4 stacks of Flow to stop it from entering cooldown after this use. All non-hero units within range of this skill are affected by the same crowd control effect.

skill3.description: Flowborn leaps to the target location and attacks, dealing 400 (400 + 70% extra AD + 8% extra max Health) physical damage and knocking back enemies for 0.75s. Deals an extra 50% damage at the center of the attack. If the skill is not on cooldown, can spend 5 stacks of Flow to stop it from entering cooldown after this use.

strategy.earlyGame: Focus on collecting resources and absorbing pressure. Your natural durability lets you trade efficiently in the Clash Lane or safely check brushes as a roamer. Prioritize your first defensive item to boost your survivability in early skirmishes.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, serve as your team's unbreakable frontline. Use your CC to initiate fights or peel for your carries. Coordinate with your jungler on invades and objective control. Your mere presence should make the enemy hesitate to contest.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you are the main initiator and damage sponge. Identify the enemy's primary damage threats and make locking them down your mission. When you dive into the heart of the enemy team, trust your supports and healers to keep you alive.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, do not hesitate. When you see an opening, force the initiation with your Ultimate and disrupt multiple enemies. Absorb all of the initial burst and CC, buying your marksmen and mages the safe time they need to clean up the fight.

combos.title: Unbreakable Vanguard
combos.description: Skill 3 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 1. Initiate from range with your massive Ultimate, drag fleeing enemies back with Skill 2, then stun with Skill 1 while reducing the damage you take.

combos.title: Peel Protocol
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1. When an assassin dives your backline, immediately use Skill 2 to drag them off your carry, then pin them in place with Skill 1.

strategy.commonMistakes: Playing too safe at full health, engaging too far away for your team to follow up, and failing to body-block projectiles aimed at your carries.

strengths: His strength is combining durability and damage through max-HP-scaling damage, healing, and shields. His healing increases with nearby allies and minions, giving him unrivaled staying power in teamfights and wave standoffs. He also boasts strong CC (knock-ups and knockbacks) through consecutive casts of Skill 2 and Skill 3 powered by his 'Flow' stacks.
weaknesses: His skills only reach full power through managing and spending 'Flow' stacks, and without them his threat drops sharply. Skill 1's value also depends on the number of nearby allies and minions, making him comparatively weak when fighting isolated. He has engage tools, but landing his CC reliably demands careful stack management and consecutive-cast timing.

582.name: Flowborn (Mage)

synergy.reason: Locks down enemies with strong CC and shields, guaranteeing the mage can land their full skill combo.
Draws enemy aggro on the frontline, creating space to safely output sustained magic damage from a distance.

counters.reason: Closes the gap with overwhelming mobility and bursts them down before they can even cast a skill.
Possesses undodgeable point-and-click hard CC that completely neutralizes all mobility.

passive.description: Flowborn can draw the Flow into their body at the Base to enhance stats (increases with level). Vitality: Increases Magical Attack by 50 and max Health by 300. Piercing Heart: Increases Magical Attack by 50 and Magical Pierce by 50. Haste: Increases Magical Attack by 50 and Movement Speed by 3.5%. Focus: Increases Magical Attack by 50 and Cooldown Reduction by 5%. Can spend 1 stack of Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack that deals 60 (60 + 12% AP) magical damage to enemies within range.

skill1.description: Flowborn channels the Flow, reducing the cooldown of other skills by 50% while gaining 5 stacks of Flow and recovering 150 (150 + 4% extra max Health) Health. Gains 1 extra stack and recovers extra Health for every teammate and every 2 minions nearby, for up to 9 stacks and double the recovery. Flowborn deals 100 (100 + 20% AP) magical damage to nearby enemies and knocks them back (without applying crowd control).

skill2.description: Flowborn controls the nearby Flow and conjures a magic circle, dealing 325 (325 + 65% AP) magical damage to enemies within range and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The magic circle deals 65 (65 + 13% AP) magical damage for 1.5s every 0.5s. Can use this skill continuously over 1.5s, with new effects in the following order. Launching Flow: Deals the same damage to enemies and launches them for 0.5s. Stunning Flow: Deals the same damage to enemies and stuns them for 0.5s. If used within the initial magic circle, both additional uses refresh the magic circle's duration and increase damage over time by 50%. Can spend 4 stacks of Flow to use the skill without triggering cooldown. The inner area of all circles inflicts an extra 50% crowd control effect.

skill3.description: Flowborn channels the Flow into a beam, dealing 700 (700 + 140% AP) magical damage to enemies in its path. The beam will link with an enemy hero within range and continuously unleash Energy Bombs, dealing 350 (350 + 70% AP) magical damage to the area around the target. Can spend 5 stacks of Flow to stop the skill from entering cooldown after this use. Other skills can be used during this skill.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early game, focus on fast wave clear to secure mid lane priority. Poke the enemy mage with your skills to force recalls, buying yourself the freedom to rotate to side lanes or help your jungler secure scuttles.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, your AoE damage becomes truly frightening. Look for tight jungle corridors where your combos can catch multiple enemies. Always position behind your frontline, and provide relentless magical bombardment in dragon fights and tower sieges.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, positioning is life or death. A single mistake gets you killed, but a properly executed full combo can vaporize the enemy team in an instant. Wait patiently for your tanks to land CC, then unleash your Ultimate.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, never push into unwarded territory. Let the fight come to you. Throw your skills from maximum range. If enemy assassins target you, use your defensive items, Flash over a wall to survive, and let your team peel for you.

combos.title: Arcane Annihilation
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3. Catch the enemy with Skill 2's CC, shred their magic defense with Skill 1, then erase them instantly with Skill 3's massive AoE damage.

combos.title: Rapid Poke
combos.description: Skill 1 -> basic attack. A low-risk, mana-efficient combo for safely harassing enemies in lane while building your passive.

strategy.commonMistakes: Face-checking brushes as a squishy mage, missing your key CC skill, and standing too close to the frontline during sieges.

strengths: Her greatest strength is that she can cast other skills while Skill 3 is channeling, combining the beam and magic circles for huge burst and sustained damage at once. Consecutive casts fueled by 'Flow' stacks let her force out damage while ignoring cooldowns and apply stuns and knock-ups. With allies nearby, her self-healing also improves, giving her solid staying power.
weaknesses: Her durability is standard mage fare, so once enemies get past Skill 1's knockback and reach her, she is extremely fragile. Her maximum damage requires spending 'Flow' stacks and layering skills onto Skill 2's magic circle, demanding a lot from her positioning and combo execution. When isolated from allies, Skill 1's benefits also shrink, keeping her from her full potential.

584.name: Flowborn (Marksman)

synergy.reason: Boosts backline survivability with shields, keeping them safe until their late-game damage scaling kicks in.
Stabilizes the laning phase with high sustain and protection, allowing the marksman to scale and shine.

counters.reason: Instantly deletes squishy marksmen with stealth engages and high burst damage.
Dives the backline with overwhelming mobility, bursting them down before there's any time to react.

passive.description: Flowborn can draw the Flow into their body at the Base, increasing Attack Speed by 10%-20% (increases with hero level) and enhancing one of four other stats. Vitality: Increases max Health by 300. Piercing Heart: Increases Physical Attack by 30. Haste: Increases Movement Speed by 3.5%. Focus: Increases Cooldown Reduction by 5%. Enhanced Basic Attack: Fires a piercing projectile, dealing 80 (80 + 20% extra AD) physical damage to enemies in its path. Hitting an enemy extends its travel distance while reducing damage by 30%. Each enhanced Basic Attack consumes 1 stack of Flow.

skill1.description: Flowborn channels the Flow, dealing 100 (100 + 25% extra AD) physical damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back (without applying crowd control). Also recovers 150 (150 + 4% extra max Health) Health, gains 5 stacks of Flow, and reduces the cooldown of Arrow of No Retreat and Arrowstorm by 50%. Nearby teammates and minions increase the recovery (up to 100%) and stacks of Flow (up to 9 stacks).

skill2.description: Flowborn shoots an enormous projectile at the target (can be blocked by enemy heroes), dealing 450 (450 + 120% extra AD) physical damage and knocking back non-hero units. Flowborn can dash a short distance upon use (use it again within 1.5s to become enhanced). Second Use: Enhances projectile damage by 25%. Third Use: Levitates and enhances projectile damage by 50%. Can spend 4 stacks of Flow to use this skill again. Casting speed increases with Attack Speed.

skill3.description: Flowborn shoots 7 volleys of light projectiles at the target location (casting speed increases with Attack Speed), dealing 90 (50 + 24% AD) physical damage (every 3 projectiles counts as 1 Basic Attack). Projectiles lock on to targets within range. Also gains a 10% Movement Speed increase. Use this skill again to levitate. Can spend 5 stacks of Flow to use this skill again.

strategy.earlyGame: Play safe and prioritize last-hitting minions above all. Your early damage is negligible, so avoid unnecessary trades with aggressive enemy marksmen. Freeze the wave near your tower and call for your jungler or roamer to help you survive the lane.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, farm everything. Clear lane minions, rotate through safe jungle camps, and hoover up every bit of gold available on the map. You need your core items to function. Only join fights when you have an overwhelming advantage or a critical objective is on the line.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you are your team's win condition. Once your items are complete, nobody matches your sustained damage. Stay glued to your support or tank. Melt whoever steps into your attack range, prioritizing the closest threat before moving up to hit the enemy backline.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, your basic attacks are your greatest weapon. Use your skills mainly for self-peel and repositioning. When the enemy frontline dives you, kite backwards while attacking nonstop. If you survive the initial burst, your lifesteal will bring you back to full and let you wipe out everyone left.

combos.title: Kite Protocol
combos.description: Basic attack -> Skill 1 -> basic attack. Fall back while attacking constantly, using Skill 1 to dash backwards and maintain distance from pursuing bruisers.

combos.title: Execute Sequence
combos.description: Skill 2 -> basic attack -> Skill 3. Apply the slow and defense shred with Skill 2, punish with empowered basic attacks, then use Skill 3 as a long-range finisher on fleeing targets.

strategy.commonMistakes: Trying to 1v1 enemy assassins, walking the jungle alone in the late game, and burning your escape skill aggressively to chase kills.

strengths: His strength is that attack speed accelerates his skill casts, letting him pump out overwhelming sustained damage with skills as well as basic attacks. Despite being a marksman, he also packs strong self-defense and mobility — a knockback and heal on Skill 1, movement and aerial attacks on Skills 2 and 3 — and consecutive casts fueled by 'Flow' stacks let him produce real burst damage too.
weaknesses: Reaching maximum damage requires properly spending 'Flow' stacks and cycling Skill 1's cooldown reduction, demanding high mechanical skill and resource management. His empowered piercing arrow also loses damage the farther it travels, so poking from long range rarely lands the killing blow — he must constantly maintain the ideal fighting distance, which takes real player skill.

synergy.reason: His AoE cleanse and CC immunity allow Florentino to continuously output damage and pick up flowers without his combos being interrupted.
By clumping enemies up, he massively increases the hit rate of Florentino's flower toss (Skill 1), letting him wipe out multiple targets at once.

counters.reason: His uncleansable suppression ultimate completely stops Florentino's fancy footwork and combos, leaving him vulnerable to getting burst down by the team.
His long-duration suppression ultimate forcefully interrupts Florentino's combo mechanics, completely neutralizing him.

passive.name: Passive: Sword Steps
passive.description:
When leaving combat or touching a bouquet, Florentino empowers his next Basic Attack (the effect lasts 5s after touching a bouquet). He dashes forward, dealing 160 (160 + 50% extra physical attack) physical damage, and recovers 140 (140 + 2% extra max Health) Health when hitting a hero (recovery is halved against non-hero units).
After the dash ends, he can quickly move a short distance.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Bloom
skill1.description:
Florentino throws a bouquet, dealing 300 (300 + 95% extra physical attack) physical damage to the first enemy hit and stunning them for 0.75s, then creates 3 bouquets around the target for 3.5s.
Touching a bouquet empowers his Basic Attack and resets the cooldown of Triple Slash.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Triple Slash
skill2.description:
Florentino strikes the target 3 times with his sword.
1st hit: deals 130 (130 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage and greatly reduces the target's Movement Speed for 1s.
2nd hit: deals 130 (130 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage.
3rd hit: deals 130 (130 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage (in 2 stages).
Each strike deals an additional 130 (130 + 40% extra physical attack) true damage to the target and reduces the cooldown of Bloom by 1s.
The first 2 strikes have a 1.5s cooldown. The skill goes on cooldown after the 3rd strike. After the attack ends, he can quickly move a short distance.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Gentleman's Duel
skill3.description:
Florentino dashes in the target direction, marking the first enemy hero hit and increasing the damage they take by 10% for 5s, then creates 3 bouquets nearby.
While the skill lasts, the Health recovery of Sword Steps' empowered Basic Attack is doubled and he gains crowd control immunity (extended by 1s each time he touches a bouquet, lasts 3s).
Touching a bouquet empowers his Basic Attack and resets the cooldown of Triple Slash.
After the dash ends, he can quickly move a short distance.

strategy.earlyGame: Master the flower pickup technique and dominate every early damage trade with your stuns and incredible healing. Dance around enemies with elegant combos starting from Skill 1 and build an overwhelming lead in lane.
strategy.midGame: Roam between lanes to land ganks, and snap towers one after another with split pushing. Use your exceptional dueling power to turn the tables on the enemy jungler and seize control of the entire map.
strategy.lateGame: At full build you become unstoppable, so bring despair to the enemy whether in teamfights or split pushing. Use your peerless dueling to divide the enemy team, then carve up their carries the instant they slip.
strategy.teamfight: Deploy your Ultimate to negate CC, then trample through the enemy team, dancing between flower pickups. Dodge enemy focus with precise skillshots and positioning, and mow everyone down with your flowing chain of attacks.

combos.title: Basic Flower Pickup Combo
combos.description: Land Skill 1 to drop three flowers, then pick them up to empower your basic attacks and reset Skill 2. Keep cycling Skill 2 as you collect flowers.

combos.title: Ultimate Duel Combo
combos.description: Land your Ultimate to lock an enemy into a duel, reducing the damage you take. Then use Skill 1 and flower pickups to impose your overwhelming 1v1 dominance.

synergy.reason: While Lorion's massive AoE knockup ultimate locks down multiple enemies, Marco Polo can safely unleash his full ultimate.
Chaining Lian Po's strong engage into Lorion's orb placement and ultimate creates a CC chain that devastates the enemy backline.

counters.reason: Zhuangzi's ultimate (team-wide CC immunity) completely negates Lorion's biggest strength: his massive AoE knockup ultimate.
With high mobility and i-frames, she easily dodges Lorion's Skill 1 orb placement and his ultimate's AoE.

skill_order.linked_note: Note: Leveling up Skill 2 also upgrades Skill 3.

passive.name: Passive: Eternity
passive.description:
Skill Activation: Deals damage on hit and activates the orb.
While the orb is outside his body, the activated orb deals 59 (59 + 12% magical attack) magical damage every 0.75s for 4s to the unit with the lowest Health in range.
While the orb is inside his body, the activated orb damages all units in range, its attack frequency is doubled, and it recovers 25 (25 + 0.4% extra Health) Health (halved for non-hero units).

skill1.name: Skill 1: Where My Will Reaches
skill1.description:
Lorion moves the orb to the target position, dealing 220 (220 + 44% magical attack) magical damage to units along its path. On hit at the destination, the orb activates and deals an additional 150 (150 + 30% magical attack) magical damage. While the orb is outside his body, casting this skill deals 250 (250 + 50% magical attack) magical damage to units between the orb's starting point and destination and reduces their Movement Speed by 20% for 1.5s.
Moving a certain distance away from the orb recalls it into his body.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Abyssal Pact
skill2.description:
While the orb is outside his body, Lorion recalls it into his body and activates it, dealing 150 (150 + 30% magical attack) magical damage and increasing his Movement Speed by 20% for 2s.
While the orb is inside his body, the cooldown is reduced by 30%.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Advent of the Dark God
skill3.description:
While the orb is outside his body, Lorion flies toward the orb and activates it, dealing 150 (150 + 30% magical attack) magical damage. While casting, he takes 25% reduced damage (lasts 2s after the flight ends) and gains crowd control immunity.
While the orb is inside his body, the cooldown is reduced by 30%.

skill4.name: Skill 4: Star of the Dark Night
skill4.description:
Lorion detonates the orb after 2s, dealing 600 (600 + 120% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies and knocking them up for 1.25s.
Casting the ultimate grants 1 stack of Skill 1.
If the ultimate does not hit a hero, its cooldown is reduced by 50%.

strategy.earlyGame: Do not force anything early — focus on last-hitting minions and slowly build an advantage with long-range harass. You are vulnerable to ganks, so maintain strictly safe positioning and never get isolated.
strategy.midGame: Once your items start coming online, group with your team and serve as the damage engine in skirmishes with your skill combos. Land your Skill 1 and Skill 2 combination precisely, and prepare yourself for the coming teamfights.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, reign as your team's main caster, slamming powerful skills from behind your frontline and shredding enemy HP in huge chunks. Do not overextend — execute your role as the carry reliably and lead your team to victory.
strategy.teamfight: Time your Ultimate with your tank's initiation and slam it into the enemy clump for devastating AoE damage. Adjust your positioning so enemy assassins can never reach you, and control the battlefield by chaining skills from safety.

combos.title: Basic Orb Control
combos.description: Hit an enemy with Skill 1's orb, then use Skill 2 to warp to the orb's position, gaining damage and a shield.

combos.title: Ultimate Control Combo
combos.description: Position the orb in the middle of the enemy group, then activate your Ultimate to knock up everyone in the area, creating the opening for your team's engage.

synergy.reason: Annette's ultimate (wind wall) completely shuts out enemy assassin dives, allowing the marksman to attack freely from the safety of the backline.
The wind wall keeps melee heroes at bay, allowing her to safely output damage from out of range.

counters.reason: They dish out heavy poke damage from far beyond the wind wall's range, easily overwhelming Annette's squishy health pool.
His high burst damage can potentially delete Annette before she even has time to deploy her ultimate.

passive.name: Passive: Whisper of the Wind
passive.description: Moving reduces skill cooldowns and restores Mana. When an ally is nearby, Movement Speed is increased by 25.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Premonition of Storm
skill1.description:
Annette summons a magic circle at the target position (triggers every 0.5s, lasts 4s). The magic circle deals 160 (160 + 28% magical attack) magical damage to enemy units and reduces their Movement Speed by 5% (up to 5 stacks, lasts 1s).
The magic circle increases allied units' Movement Speed by 5% (up to 5 stacks, lasts 1s).

skill2.name: Skill 2: Wind Guard
skill2.description:
Annette launches an orb in the target direction (bouncing herself in the opposite direction), gaining a 400 (400 + 6% extra magical attack) shield for 3s and 75 bonus Movement Speed for 2s.
The orb deals 300 (300 + 50% magical attack) magical damage to enemies it hits and grants allies it hits a 400 (400 + 6% extra magical attack) shield.
If the orb touches a magic circle from Premonition of Storm, it carries the magic circle to its destination.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Veil of the Spring Breeze
skill3.description:
Annette summons a barrier around herself (lasts 4s, can move), knocking back enemies in range and dealing 300 (300 + 50% magical attack) magical damage. Enemies touching the barrier take the same damage and are stunned for 1.25s, while allies inside the barrier gain crowd control immunity.
While casting, Annette becomes untargetable and her Movement Speed is reduced by 50%.

strategy.earlyGame: Use Skill 1's magic circle to speed up your wave clear and take mid lane priority. Ideally, follow your jungler's movements and join ganks aggressively while shielding them with Skill 2.
strategy.midGame: This is when mid-sized teamfights break out. Always move with your team and use your passive's movement speed boost to stay flexible. Using your Ultimate (Skill 3) to answer enemy CC and engages, protecting your teammates, is what matters most.
strategy.lateGame: Teamfights decide the game in this phase. Do not step up carelessly — keep shielding allies from the backline while poking with Skill 1. The timing of your Ultimate decides everything, so hold it to protect your carries from enemy assassins and fighters.
strategy.teamfight: Position near your carry, and when the enemy dives, use your Ultimate (Skill 3) to split them off and knock them back. Allies inside the barrier gain crowd control immunity, making it a powerful counter to enemy CC. The key is moving the magic circle with Skill 2's orb, supplying damage and shields simultaneously and continuously.

combos.title: Basic Poke Combo
combos.description: Alternate Skill 1 and Skill 2 to continuously deal magic damage and slows to enemies from long range.

combos.title: Ultimate Split Combo
combos.description: Create the giant cyclone with your Ultimate to divide the enemy team or peel for allies, shaping the fight into a favorable formation.

synergy.reason: He grants CC immunity and damage reduction, allowing her to chain resets and secure kills uninterrupted.
His long-range stun can lock down enemies, creating a safe opening for Butterfly to dive.

counters.reason: His AoE CC and high sustain can easily break the chain of Butterfly's skill resets.
Her i-frames and healing allow her to dodge Butterfly's burst and easily turn the fight.

passive.description: Butterfly gains 2 marks from defeating heroes and 1 mark from assists and from killing monsters/minions. At 3 stacks, the next skill used will not enter cooldown.

skill1.description: Butterfly deals 362 (240 + 70% physical damage) to nearby enemies. Each extra enemy hit increases damage by 25%. Also gains a shield that negates 381 (250 + 75% Physical Attack) damage lasting 2s, and gains 50% Movement Speed that diminishes over time.

skill2.description: Butterfly deals 333 (220 + 65% physical damage) to enemies in her path. The first enemy hit takes 1.5 times this damage and is slowed by 50% for 1.5s. Hitting an enemy increases her Attack Speed by 25% and Critical Rate by 10% for 4s, for up to 2 stacks.

skill3.description: Butterfly jumps to a target enemy, dealing 557 (400 + 90% physical damage) (if the target is marked, deals extra true damage equal to 12% lost Health) and marking them for 4s. For 4s after hitting the target, she takes 50% less damage from all Basic Attacks. While the mark is active, she recovers Health equal to 35% of damage dealt to the target. If the target is defeated, it will immediately reset her Ultimate's cooldown. Hitting marked targets with Basic Attacks will also reduce the cooldown of Skills 1 and 2 by 1s.

strategy.earlyGame: Farm relentlessly until level 4, then unleash full-throttle ganks the moment you learn your Ultimate. Early kills are the key to your snowball, so never let an enemy in a lazy position off the hook.
strategy.midGame: In the mid game, pressure lanes while forcibly taking open towers and major objectives. The instant an enemy mage or marksman steps into the jungle, ambush them from the brush and erase them from the map.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, leverage your overwhelming backline assassination power and become the hunter who farms isolated carries. In teamfights, do not dive first — wait for the enemy's CC to be spent, then sweep through and clean up.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, wait for the perfect moment when enemies are low, then enter with your Ultimate and chain kill after kill to keep resetting your skills. Tear through the battlefield in a whirlwind of consecutive kills and thoroughly dismantle the enemy team.

combos.title: Basic Assassin Combo
combos.description: Leap onto an enemy with your Ultimate, then use Skill 1's slow and Skill 2's attack speed boost to burst them down with basic attacks.

combos.title: Kill Reset Chain
combos.description: Exploit the passive that resets cooldowns on kills and assists: Ultimate -> 1 -> 2 -> basic attacks to kill one target, then immediately leap to the next with another Ultimate.

strengths: Her greatest strengths are the cooldown clearing from her passive and the Ultimate reset on kills from Skill 3, giving her overwhelming chain-kill potential. She is peerless when enemies are low on health, with the explosive power to flip a fight single-handedly. On top of that, Skill 1's shield and Skill 3's healing and basic-attack damage reduction give this assassin remarkably high survivability in extended brawls.
weaknesses: Her weakness is that without securing kills or assists, her passive gives her nothing and her damage falls off sharply. She also lacks the tools to initiate teamfights herself, and her fragility shows when enemy CC catches her. When enemies stack armor and keep their HP high, or a support guards targets with strong shields, her signature kill resets never come online and her impact on fights collapses.
